title.zh-CN: 呕吐、腹痛伴呼吸急促 · 24岁女性
title.en: Vomiting, abdominal pain and fast breathing · 24-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 24岁女性，呕吐、腹痛两天，凌晨由室友送入急诊抢救室，呼吸深快、精神萎靡。时间敏感的急诊—重症模拟：评估、判读、按正确顺序安全处置，并随病情演变在数小时内调整治疗直至安全过渡。
summary.en: A 24-year-old woman is brought to the emergency department by her roommate in the early hours after two days of vomiting and abdominal pain; she is breathing deeply and fast and looks exhausted. A time-critical emergency/critical-care simulation: assess, interpret, treat safely in the right order, and adjust treatment over several simulated hours until a safe handover.

notes.zh-CN: 完全虚构的教学病例，依据ADA/EASD等2024年成人高血糖危象共识、英国JBDS-IP成人DKA指南及中华医学会糖尿病学分会相关指南编写；姓名均为化名，不对应任何真实患者；所有数值为教学而设定并经内部一致性核对。
notes.en: Entirely fictional teaching case written to the 2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS/AACE/DTS consensus on hyperglycaemic crises in adults, the JBDS-IP adult DKA guideline and Chinese Diabetes Society guidance; all names are pseudonyms and correspond to no real patient; every number was written for teaching and checked for internal consistency.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例，不构成医疗建议。
disclaimer.en: Fictional teaching case — not medical advice.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 呕吐、腹痛2天，今夜呼吸急促
chiefComplaint.en: Two days of vomiting and abdominal pain; fast breathing tonight

triageNote.zh-CN: 24岁女性，02:40由室友打车送来急诊，诉呕吐、腹痛约2天，今夜呼吸明显加快。分诊：HR 118次/分，BP 100/60 mmHg（MAP 73），RR 28次/分（呼吸深大），SpO₂ 99%（未吸氧），T 37.4 °C，GCS 15，腹痛6/10。精神萎靡、口唇干燥。已送入抢救室3床，尚未建立静脉通路，尚未测指尖血糖。
triageNote.en: 24-year-old woman brought in by her roommate by taxi at 02:40 with about 2 days of vomiting and abdominal pain; her breathing has become much faster tonight. Triage: HR 118/min, BP 100/60 mmHg (MAP 73), RR 28/min (deep breaths), SpO₂ 99% on room air, T 37.4 °C, GCS 15, abdominal pain 6/10. Looks exhausted, lips dry. Placed in resus bay 3; no IV access yet; capillary glucose not yet checked.

personality.zh-CN: 认真、要强的在读研究生，平时自己管理慢性病很少求助；此刻疲惫、害怕，又因为觉得“是自己没管好”而有些难为情，容易道歉；配合治疗。
personality.en: A conscientious, independent graduate student who usually manages her long-term condition on her own; now exhausted and frightened, a little embarrassed because she feels she 'let it happen', quick to apologise; cooperative.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 普通话口语，因呼吸深快说话断断续续，每说几个字要深吸一口气；会用“基础率”“大剂量”“管路”等泵使用者的日常说法，但不用医学诊断术语。
speechStyle.en: Plain everyday English in short bursts, stopping every few words for a deep breath; uses everyday pump-user words such as 'basal', 'bolus' and 'set', but no medical diagnostic terms.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生……我吐了两天了……肚子疼……特别渴……怎么喘都喘不过气来。
openingLine.en: Doctor... I've been throwing up for two days... my stomach hurts... I'm so thirsty... and I can't get enough air.

fallbackUnknown.en: I'm not sure about that, doctor.

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是我自己没管好才弄成这样的？
concerns.en: Did I bring this on myself?

concerns.zh-CN: 我下周就要论文答辩了，什么时候能出院？
concerns.en: My thesis defence is next week — when can I go home?

concerns.zh-CN: 我的胰岛素泵是不是坏了？以后还能用吗？
concerns.en: Is my insulin pump broken? Can I keep using it?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 呼吸深大而规则，每说几个字就停下深吸一口气；嘴唇干，偶尔干呕，手边放着呕吐袋；疲惫但定向力正常。谈到漏打胰岛素时难为情、语气低，容易自责。若监护提示频发早搏/低钾（例如过早使用胰岛素后），表现为心慌、双腿发软无力；若发生低血糖，表现为出冷汗、手抖、焦虑；严重低血糖时嗜睡、要大声叫才应答、说话含糊，血糖纠正后恢复。随着治疗推进（后期阶段）呼吸逐渐平稳、恶心缓解，开始说饿、话也多起来。只回答被问到的病史，不主动补充细节，不说出任何诊断或化验数值。
actingNotes.en: Deep, regular breathing; stops every few words to take a deep breath. Dry lips, occasional retching, a vomit bowl at hand; exhausted but fully oriented. Embarrassed and quiet when talking about missed insulin; tends to blame herself. If the monitor shows frequent ectopics/low potassium (e.g. after insulin started too early) she complains of palpitations and weak, heavy legs; if she becomes hypoglycaemic she is sweaty, shaky and anxious; if severely hypoglycaemic she is drowsy, answers only to a raised voice and slurs her words until the glucose is corrected. As treatment progresses (later phases) her breathing settles, the nausea eases, she says she is hungry and becomes chattier. Only answers history she is asked about, adds no details of her own, never states a diagnosis or a lab value.

persona.zh-CN: 二十多岁，与患者合租的同学，半夜被患者粗重的喘气声吵醒后打车送她来医院；焦急但镇定，会帮忙拿东西、联系患者家人；不替患者回答病史。
persona.en: In her twenties, a fellow student who shares the flat; woke in the night to the patient's heavy breathing and brought her by taxi. Worried but steady; fetches things and contacts the family; does not answer history questions for the patient.

label.zh-CN: 到院第1小时：急诊抢救室

description.zh-CN: 到院后的初始评估、确诊与初始复苏。时间按模拟时钟推进，病情随时间和治疗变化。
description.en: Initial assessment, diagnosis and first resuscitation after arrival. Time runs on the simulated clock; her condition evolves with time and treatment.

description.zh-CN: 开始静脉补钾一段时间后自动进入（补钾开始越晚，进入越晚）。此阶段新开的检查反映补液、补钾后的状态。
description.en: Entered automatically once IV potassium has been running for a while (the later it starts, the later this phase begins). Tests ordered in this phase reflect her state after fluids and potassium.

label.zh-CN: 血糖降至14 mmol/L以下（约第5小时）

description.zh-CN: 静脉胰岛素输注后毛细血管血糖首次降至14 mmol/L以下时自动进入。此阶段的检查结果代表该时点前后的采样。
description.en: Entered automatically when capillary glucose first falls below 14 mmol/L on the insulin infusion. Results in this phase represent samples taken around that time.

label.zh-CN: 酸中毒纠正与过渡（约第10小时）

description.zh-CN: 持续静脉胰岛素后呼吸恢复平稳时自动进入：复查并判断是否已缓解，安排皮下胰岛素过渡与后续去向。
description.en: Entered automatically once her breathing has settled on continued IV insulin: recheck, judge whether the episode has resolved, and plan the switch to subcutaneous insulin and onward care.

question.zh-CN: 今天哪里不舒服？
question.en: What's brought you in today?

answer.zh-CN: 吐了两天……肚子疼……特别口渴……现在喘不上气，怎么吸都觉得不够。
answer.en: I've been throwing up for two days... my stomach hurts... I'm so thirsty... and now I can't catch my breath — however deep I breathe it's not enough.

en: how can I help you today
what seems to be the problem

question.zh-CN: 这些症状什么时候开始的？是怎么发展的？
question.en: When did this start, and how has it progressed?

answer.zh-CN: 前天下午开始恶心、吐，后来还拉肚子。昨天一直特别渴、不停上厕所。今天晚上肚子越来越疼，喘气也越来越费劲，室友半夜被我喘气的声音吵醒，就打车把我送来了。
answer.en: It started the day before yesterday in the afternoon — feeling sick, then vomiting, and some diarrhoea. Yesterday I was desperately thirsty and peeing all the time. Tonight the stomach pain got worse and breathing got harder and harder. My roommate woke up to my breathing in the middle of the night and brought me here in a taxi.

en: how long have you been unwell
how long has this been going on

question.zh-CN: 这两天吃喝怎么样？最后一次正经吃饭是什么时候？
question.en: How have you been eating and drinking? When did you last have a proper meal?

answer.zh-CN: 前天中午吃了顿午饭，之后基本就没吃过东西了。昨天到现在只能小口抿点水，喝多了就吐出来。
answer.en: Lunch the day before yesterday was my last proper meal — I've hardly eaten anything since. Since yesterday I can only sip water; if I drink more it comes straight back up.

question.zh-CN: 吐了多少次？吐的是什么？
question.en: How many times have you vomited, and what has come up?

answer.zh-CN: 从昨天到现在大概吐了六到八次吧。都是喝下去的水，还有黄黄的、很苦的东西。没有血，也没有像咖啡渣那样的。
answer.en: Maybe six to eight times since yesterday. Just the water I drink and some yellow, bitter stuff. No blood, nothing like coffee grounds.

question.zh-CN: 有没有拉肚子？大便什么样？
question.en: Any diarrhoea? What are your stools like?

answer.zh-CN: 前天拉了三次，稀水样的。昨天开始就没拉了。没有血，也没有黏液。
answer.en: Three times the day before yesterday — watery. None since yesterday. No blood, no mucus.

question.zh-CN: 肚子哪里疼？是怎么样的疼？有多严重？
question.en: Where is the abdominal pain, what is it like and how bad is it?

answer.zh-CN: 整个肚子都疼，主要在肚脐周围和上面中间。开始是一阵一阵绞着疼，现在一直疼。要打分的话六分吧。不往背上跑。
answer.en: All over my tummy, mostly around the belly button and the upper middle. At first it came in cramping waves, now it's constant. About six out of ten. It doesn't go through to my back.

question.zh-CN: 有什么让腹痛加重或减轻吗？
question.en: Does anything make the pain better or worse?

answer.zh-CN: 好像没什么能让它好一点。吐完以后更疼。动一动、翻身倒没觉得更厉害。
answer.en: Nothing really makes it better. It's worse after I've been sick. Moving or turning over doesn't really make it worse.

question.zh-CN: 口渴吗？小便多不多？
question.en: Have you been thirsty or passing more urine than usual?

answer.zh-CN: 渴得要命，一直想喝水，可是喝下去又吐出来。小便特别多，昨天夜里差不多每个钟头起来一次。最后一次是来医院前一个小时左右。
answer.en: Desperately thirsty — I keep wanting to drink but it comes back up. I've been peeing loads; last night I was up about every hour. The last time was about an hour before I came in.

question.zh-CN: 呼吸怎么样？有胸痛或咳嗽吗？
question.en: Tell me about your breathing — any chest pain or cough?

answer.zh-CN: 就是觉得气不够用，总想深深地吸气，越喘越累。胸口不疼，也不咳嗽。
answer.en: It just feels like I can't get enough air — I keep needing to take big deep breaths and it's exhausting. My chest doesn't hurt and I'm not coughing.

question.zh-CN: 有没有犯困、迷糊或反应慢？
question.en: Have you been drowsy, confused or slow?

answer.zh-CN: 特别累，老想睡。室友说我刚才说话有点含糊。不过我知道自己在医院。
answer.en: Really tired — I just want to sleep. My roommate said I was mumbling earlier. But I know I'm in hospital.

question.zh-CN: 有没有头痛、看东西模糊、心慌，或者肌肉抽筋、没力气？
question.en: Any headache, blurred vision, palpitations, muscle cramps or weakness?

answer.zh-CN: 头不疼，看东西也还清楚。就是浑身没劲、特别累。心跳感觉有点快，但没有乱跳的感觉；腿也没抽筋。
answer.en: No headache, and my eyesight's fine. I just feel weak all over and exhausted. My heart feels a bit fast, but it isn't skipping or fluttering, and I've had no cramps.

question.zh-CN: 最近体重有变化吗？
question.en: Have you lost any weight recently?

answer.zh-CN: 这几天裤子都松了，估计掉了两公斤左右。
answer.en: My jeans feel loose — I've probably lost about two kilos in the last few days.

question.zh-CN: 这两天在家测血糖了吗？多少？用的是指尖血糖仪还是动态血糖探头？
question.en: Have you checked your blood sugar at home? What were the readings? Do you use a finger-prick meter or a sensor?

answer.zh-CN: 昨天下午测过一次，二十多，好像是24点几。泵提示要补一针校正，我想着生病时血糖高一点正常、又吃不下东西，就取消了……之后就没再测。我没戴动态血糖探头，都是用指尖血糖仪测。
answer.en: I checked once yesterday afternoon — it was in the twenties, 24-something I think. The pump suggested a correction but I thought sugars run high when you're ill, and I wasn't eating, so I cancelled it... I didn't check again after that. I don't wear a sensor — I just use a finger-prick meter.

question.zh-CN: 在家测过血酮或尿酮吗？
question.en: Did you check your ketones at home?

answer.zh-CN: 没有……家里没有酮体试纸，以前那盒早就过期扔了。
answer.en: No... I don't have any ketone strips at home. The last box expired ages ago and I threw it out.

question.zh-CN: 你平时怎么用胰岛素？胰岛素泵这几天有没有出问题？
question.en: How do you take your insulin? Has your insulin pump had any problems these last few days?

answer.zh-CN: 我用胰岛素泵，装的是门冬胰岛素。前天夜里十一点多泵开始报警，说“堵塞”。我吐得一点力气都没有，就按掉接着睡了。后来又响了好几次，我都按掉了……一直没换管路。
answer.en: I use an insulin pump with aspart. The night before last, a bit after eleven, it started alarming — 'occlusion'. I was so wiped out from vomiting that I just cleared it and went back to sleep. It went off several more times and I kept clearing it... I never changed the set.

question.zh-CN: 生病这两天，你的胰岛素（餐前大剂量、校正剂量）是怎么打的？
question.en: While you've been ill, how have you been doing your insulin — meal boluses and corrections?

answer.zh-CN: 我吃不下东西，就没打餐前的大剂量……我以为不吃饭就该少打或者不打胰岛素。校正剂量也没打。
answer.en: I couldn't eat, so I didn't do any meal boluses... I thought if you're not eating you should take less insulin or none. I didn't do any corrections either.

question.zh-CN: 输注管路和针头最后一次是什么时候换的？扎在哪里？
question.en: When did you last change your infusion set and cannula, and where is it sited?

answer.zh-CN: 四天前换的……其实应该两三天换一次。针在左下腹。
answer.en: Four days ago... I know it's supposed to be every two to three days. It's in the left side of my lower tummy.

question.zh-CN: 你的泵设置是怎样的？一天大概用多少胰岛素？
question.en: What are your pump settings, and how much insulin do you use in a day?

answer.zh-CN: 基础率每小时0.6到0.9单位，一天加起来18单位左右。吃饭按1单位配10克碳水算。一天总共大概35个单位。
answer.en: Basal is 0.6 to 0.9 units an hour — about 18 units a day in total. For meals it's 1 unit per 10 grams of carbs. Altogether about 35 units a day.

question.zh-CN: 有没有人教过你生病时怎么调整胰岛素（生病日规则）？泵出问题时有备用的胰岛素笔吗？
question.en: Has anyone taught you what to do with your insulin when you're ill — sick-day rules? Do you have backup insulin pens for when the pump fails?

answer.zh-CN: 小时候在儿科门诊好像讲过……说实话具体怎么做我已经不记得了。家里倒是有一支备用的门冬胰岛素笔，可当时根本没想起来用。
answer.en: I think they went through it at the children's clinic years ago... honestly I don't remember what you're supposed to do. I do have a spare aspart pen at home, but it never crossed my mind to use it.

question.zh-CN: 有没有发热、寒战？
question.en: Any fever or shivering?

answer.zh-CN: 第一天晚上忽冷忽热的，没量体温。之后没有发抖。
answer.en: The first night I felt hot and cold, but I didn't take my temperature. No shivering since.

question.zh-CN: 小便时有没有疼痛、灼热，或者尿有异味？
question.en: Any pain or burning when passing urine, or smelly urine?

answer.zh-CN: 不疼也不烧，也没什么怪味，就是尿特别多。
answer.en: No pain or burning, no funny smell — just a lot of it.

question.zh-CN: 最近有没有感冒、咽痛、咳嗽这些症状？
question.en: Any cold, sore throat or cough recently?

answer.zh-CN: 没有，嗓子不疼，也没流鼻涕、没咳嗽。
answer.en: No — no sore throat, no runny nose, no cough.

question.zh-CN: 身边有人最近也生病吗？最近吃过什么特别的东西、或者出过远门吗？
question.en: Has anyone around you been unwell? Have you eaten anything unusual or travelled recently?

answer.zh-CN: 室友上周也上吐下泻，两天就好了。我们平时都在家自己做饭，最近没在外面乱吃东西，也没出过远门。
answer.en: My roommate had vomiting and diarrhoea last week — she was better in two days. We mostly cook at home — I haven't eaten anything unusual and haven't been away anywhere.

question.zh-CN: 以前有什么病？糖尿病平时在哪里随访？
question.en: Do you have any medical conditions? Where is your diabetes followed up?

answer.zh-CN: 我11岁得的1型糖尿病，当时就是因为酮症酸中毒住院查出来的。三年前查出甲状腺功能减退。别的没什么。平时在医院内分泌科门诊随访，大概半年去一次。
answer.en: I've had type 1 diabetes since I was eleven — I was found to have it when I was admitted with ketoacidosis. I was diagnosed with an underactive thyroid three years ago. Nothing else. I'm followed up in the hospital diabetes clinic about every six months.

question.zh-CN: 以前有没有发生过类似情况或因为糖尿病住院？有没有低血糖？
question.en: Have you ever had anything like this before, or been in hospital because of your diabetes? Any hypos?

answer.zh-CN: 只有11岁刚发现糖尿病那次，在ICU住了两天。之后就没再因为糖尿病住过院。低血糖也就是偶尔有轻微的，自己能感觉出来，吃点糖就好了，从来没因为低血糖叫过救护车。
answer.en: Only when I was diagnosed at eleven — I was in intensive care for two days. I haven't been in hospital for my diabetes since. Hypos — just the odd mild one that I can feel coming and sort out with some sugar; I've never needed an ambulance for one.

question.zh-CN: 糖尿病有没有影响到眼睛、肾脏或者手脚神经？
question.en: Has your diabetes affected your eyes, kidneys or nerves?

answer.zh-CN: 去年查眼底没问题，查小便蛋白也正常，手脚不麻。
answer.en: My eye check last year was fine, the urine protein test was normal, and I've got no numbness.

question.zh-CN: 以前做过手术吗？
question.en: Have you ever had an operation?

answer.zh-CN: 没做过手术。
answer.en: No, I've never had an operation.

question.zh-CN: 除了胰岛素，还用什么药吗？
question.en: Apart from insulin, do you take any other medicines?

answer.zh-CN: 每天早上吃左甲状腺素，50微克。昨天吐得厉害，没吃进去。别的药都没有，没吃降糖药片。
answer.en: Levothyroxine 50 micrograms every morning — I couldn't keep it down yesterday. Nothing else, no diabetes tablets.

question.zh-CN: 有没有吃过“格列净”类药物（SGLT2抑制剂），比如为了控制体重？
question.en: Have you taken any 'gliflozin' (SGLT2-inhibitor) tablets, for example for weight?

answer.zh-CN: 没有，从来没吃过，我只用胰岛素。
answer.en: No, never. Only insulin.

question.zh-CN: 对什么药物过敏吗？
question.en: Are you allergic to any medicines?

answer.zh-CN: 没有，我知道的药都不过敏。
answer.en: No — no allergies to any medicines that I know of.

question.zh-CN: 末次月经是什么时候？有没有可能怀孕？
question.en: When was your last period, and is there any chance you could be pregnant?

answer.zh-CN: 两周前刚结束，月经一直挺规律的。我有男朋友，我们一直用避孕套。应该不会吧。
answer.en: It finished about two weeks ago — always regular. I have a boyfriend; we always use condoms. I don't think so.

question.zh-CN: 抽烟喝酒吗？
question.en: Do you smoke or drink alcohol?

answer.zh-CN: 不抽烟。酒很少喝，大概一个月一杯红酒，这周一点都没喝。
answer.en: I don't smoke. I hardly drink — maybe a glass of wine a month, and none at all this week.

question.zh-CN: 有没有用过大麻或其他娱乐性药物？
question.en: Have you used cannabis or any recreational drugs?

answer.zh-CN: 没有，从来没碰过。
answer.en: No, never.

question.zh-CN: 你现在做什么？和谁住在一起？
question.en: What do you do, and who do you live with?

answer.zh-CN: 我在读研究生，和送我来的这个同学合租一套房子。
answer.en: I'm a master's student. I share a flat with the friend who brought me in.

question.zh-CN: 家里人有什么病吗？
question.en: Does anything run in your family?

answer.zh-CN: 我妈妈有甲状腺的毛病。家里没有别人得糖尿病。
answer.en: My mum has a thyroid problem. No one else in the family has diabetes.

question.zh-CN: 你最担心的是什么？你觉得是怎么回事？
question.en: What are you most worried about? What do you think is going on?

answer.zh-CN: 我是不是自己把自己弄成这样的……下周就要论文答辩了。还有，我的泵是不是坏了，以后还能不能用？
answer.en: Did I do this to myself... my thesis defence is next week. And is my pump broken — will I still be able to use it?

question.zh-CN: 你体重和身高大概多少？
question.en: Roughly how much do you weigh, and how tall are you?

answer.zh-CN: 平时57公斤左右，这几天估计掉了两公斤。身高一米六三。
answer.en: Usually about 57 kilos — probably a couple of kilos less these last few days. I'm one metre sixty-three.

question.zh-CN: 血糖仪里存的具体读数和时间是多少？
question.en: What exact readings and times are stored in your glucose meter?

answer.zh-CN: 我没记下来，也说不清具体数字和时间……要看血糖仪才知道。
answer.en: I didn't write anything down and I can't tell you the exact numbers or times... you'd have to look at the meter.

question.zh-CN: 你室友上次是什么病？查出来是什么原因吗？
question.en: What was your roommate's illness — was a cause found?

answer.zh-CN: 不知道，她没去看医生，自己就好了。
answer.en: I don't know — she never saw a doctor, she just got better.

question.zh-CN: 你上次糖化血红蛋白是多少？
question.en: What was your last HbA1c?

answer.zh-CN: 具体数字我不记得了……上次复查大概是半年前。
answer.en: I can't remember the number... my last check-up was about six months ago.

question.zh-CN: 现在感觉怎么样？比刚来的时候好点了吗？
question.en: How are you feeling now — any better than when you came in?

answer.zh-CN: 比刚来的时候好些了……气没那么急了，嘴里也没那么干了。肚子还是有点疼，主要在上面，比刚来时轻一点；恶心也轻了一些，不过还不太想吃东西。
answer.en: Better than when I came in... I'm not gasping for air so much, and my mouth isn't as dry. My tummy still hurts a bit, mostly at the top, but less than before; I feel less sick too — though I don't really feel like eating yet.

question.zh-CN: 现在感觉怎么样？能吃东西了吗？
question.en: How are you feeling now — could you eat something?

answer.zh-CN: 好多了！呼吸顺了，人也精神了，肚子基本不疼了，也不恶心了。现在倒是饿了，挺想吃点东西、喝点水的。
answer.en: So much better! My breathing's back to normal, I feel much more awake, my tummy hardly hurts now and I don't feel sick any more. I'm actually hungry — I'd love something to eat and drink.

finding.zh-CN: 消瘦的年轻女性，半卧于抢救床上，面色苍白、疲惫，呼吸深大，每隔几个字就要深吸一口气；神志清楚，能正确回答问题，但反应略慢。手边放着呕吐袋。无发绀。
finding.en: Slim young woman propped up on the trolley, pale and exhausted, breathing deeply, stopping for a deep breath every few words; alert and answering appropriately but a little slow. A vomit bowl is at hand. No cyanosis.

maneuver.zh-CN: 观察呼吸型态（频率、深度、节律）

finding.zh-CN: 呼吸深大、规则而急促（库斯莫尔呼吸），约28次/分；无辅助呼吸肌参与、无鼻翼扇动、无喘鸣或哮鸣；双侧胸廓起伏对称。
finding.en: Deep, regular, rapid breathing (Kussmaul respiration) at about 28/min; no accessory-muscle use, no nasal flaring, no stridor or wheeze; chest expansion symmetrical.

finding.zh-CN: 呼气中可闻及明显的烂苹果样（丙酮）气味。
finding.en: A distinct sweet, fruity (acetone, 'nail-varnish remover') smell on her breath.

maneuver.zh-CN: 评估容量状态（黏膜、皮肤弹性、毛细血管再充盈）
maneuver.en: Assess hydration (mucous membranes, skin turgor, capillary refill)

finding.zh-CN: 口唇及舌面干燥，皮肤弹性减低，眼窝轻度凹陷；中心毛细血管再充盈时间3秒；四肢末梢偏凉；颈静脉平卧位不显露。
finding.en: Dry lips and tongue, reduced skin turgor, mildly sunken eyes; central capillary refill 3 s; cool peripheries; JVP not visible lying flat.

finding.zh-CN: 心率快、节律规整，S1、S2正常，未闻及杂音、奔马律或心包摩擦音。
finding.en: Tachycardic and regular; normal S1 and S2; no murmurs, gallop or rub.

finding.zh-CN: 双肺呼吸音清，进气良好，未闻及干湿啰音；叩诊清音。
finding.en: Clear vesicular breath sounds with good air entry bilaterally; no crackles or wheeze; resonant to percussion.

maneuver.en: Examine the abdomen (inspect, palpate, percuss, auscultate)

finding.zh-CN: 腹平软，脐周及上腹部弥漫性轻压痛，无肌紧张、无反跳痛，无叩击痛；Murphy征阴性，麦氏点无压痛；未触及包块，肝脾肋下未触及；肠鸣音减弱但存在。左下腹可见胰岛素泵软管留置处。
finding.en: Soft, flat abdomen with mild diffuse peri-umbilical and epigastric tenderness; no guarding, no rebound, no percussion tenderness; Murphy's sign negative, no McBurney's-point tenderness; no masses, no organomegaly; bowel sounds reduced but present. A pump cannula is sited in the left lower quadrant.

maneuver.zh-CN: 检查胰岛素泵及输注部位
maneuver.en: Inspect the insulin pump and infusion site

finding.zh-CN: 胰岛素泵别在睡裤腰带上，屏幕历史记录显示多次“堵塞报警”；输注管路在接头附近明显打折。左下腹皮下软管留置处见约1 cm红晕，无硬结、无渗液或脓液。脐周旧注射部位轻度脂肪增生。
finding.en: The pump is clipped to her pyjama waistband; its alarm history shows repeated 'occlusion' alarms, and the tubing is sharply kinked near the connector. At the left-lower-quadrant cannula site there is about 1 cm of erythema without induration, discharge or pus. Mild lipohypertrophy at old peri-umbilical sites.

maneuver.zh-CN: 神经系统检查（意识、瞳孔、局灶体征、脑膜刺激征）
maneuver.en: Neurological exam (consciousness, pupils, focal signs, meningism)

finding.zh-CN: GCS 15（E4V5M6），时间、地点、人物定向力正常，应答稍慢；双侧瞳孔等大等圆、对光反射灵敏；无局灶神经体征；颈软，无脑膜刺激征。
finding.en: GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6), oriented to time, place and person, a little slow to answer; pupils equal and reactive; no focal neurological signs; neck supple, no meningism.

finding.zh-CN: 四肢肌张力正常，肌力5/5且对称；腱反射对称引出（2+），病理征阴性。
finding.en: Normal tone; power 5/5 and symmetrical in all limbs; reflexes present and symmetrical (2+); plantars flexor.

finding.zh-CN: 双侧视盘边界清晰，无视乳头水肿；未见出血或渗出。
finding.en: Sharp optic disc margins bilaterally, no papilloedema; no haemorrhages or exudates.

finding.zh-CN: 全身未见皮疹、瘀点；除泵管留置处轻度红晕外，未见蜂窝织炎、脓肿或其他感染灶。
finding.en: No rash or petechiae; apart from the mild redness at the pump site there is no cellulitis, abscess or other skin infection.

finding.zh-CN: 咽部干燥，无充血，扁桃体不大、无渗出；双侧鼓膜正常。
finding.en: Dry pharynx without erythema; tonsils not enlarged, no exudate; both tympanic membranes normal.
No renal-angle tenderness on either side.

finding.zh-CN: 甲状腺不大、无压痛，未触及结节；颈部淋巴结未触及肿大。
finding.en: Thyroid not enlarged or tender, no nodules; no cervical lymphadenopathy.

maneuver.zh-CN: 称体重（抢救床自带称重）
治疗后复评：呼吸、容量与腹部（中期）
maneuver.en: Reassess after treatment: breathing, hydration and abdomen (midway)

finding.zh-CN: 呼吸仍偏深，但频率较到院时减慢；口唇较前湿润，末梢转暖，毛细血管再充盈2秒；腹部压痛减轻，仍有轻度上腹不适；神志清楚、对答切题，恶心减轻。
finding.en: Breathing still somewhat deep but slower than on arrival; lips moister, peripheries warmer, capillary refill 2 s; abdominal tenderness reduced, mild epigastric discomfort only; alert and appropriate, less nauseated.

maneuver.zh-CN: 治疗后复评：呼吸、容量、神志与腹部（后期）
maneuver.en: Reassess after treatment: breathing, hydration, alertness and abdomen (late)

finding.zh-CN: 呼吸平稳、深度正常，不再有深大呼吸；口唇湿润，末梢温暖；神志清楚，坐起来说想吃东西；腹软，无压痛；呼气已无明显酮味。
finding.en: Breathing quiet and of normal depth — no longer Kussmaul; moist mucous membranes, warm peripheries; alert, sitting up and asking for something to eat; abdomen soft and non-tender; no obvious ketotic smell on the breath now.

text.zh-CN: 12导联心电图：窦性心动过速，118次/分，节律规整。PR间期0.16 s，QRS 0.08 s，电轴正常。广泛T波低平，V4–V6导联ST段轻度压低（约0.5 mm）；V2–V3导联T波后可见U波，部分与其后的P波融合；QT约0.30 s（心率快时QTc难以准确评估）。无T波高尖、无ST段抬高、无传导阻滞或心律失常。印象：窦性心动过速；T波低平、ST段轻度压低伴U波——符合低钾血症改变。
text.en: 12-lead ECG: sinus tachycardia, 118/min, regular. PR 0.16 s, QRS 0.08 s, normal axis. Widespread T-wave flattening with about 0.5 mm ST depression in V4–V6; U waves after the T waves in V2–V3, partly merging with the following P waves; QT about 0.30 s (QTc unreliable at this rate). No peaked T waves, no ST elevation, no conduction block or arrhythmia. Impression: sinus tachycardia; flat T waves, minor ST depression and U waves — changes consistent with hypokalaemia.

note.zh-CN: 无既往心电图可供对比。
note.en: No previous ECG is available for comparison.

text.zh-CN: 复查12导联心电图：窦性心动过速，约108次/分。T波仍偏低平，U波较前变小；无ST段抬高，无心律失常。
text.en: Repeat 12-lead ECG: sinus tachycardia, about 108/min. T waves still low; U waves smaller than before; no ST elevation, no arrhythmia.

text.zh-CN: 复查12导联心电图：窦性心律，约96次/分。T波直立，U波已不明显，QTc 430 ms；无ST段改变。
text.en: Repeat 12-lead ECG: sinus rhythm, about 96/min. Upright T waves, U waves no longer prominent, QTc 430 ms; no ST changes.

text.zh-CN: 复查12导联心电图：窦性心律，约86次/分，心电图正常，QTc 420 ms。
text.en: Repeat 12-lead ECG: sinus rhythm, about 86/min; normal ECG, QTc 420 ms.

text.zh-CN: 脂肪酶 42 U/L；淀粉酶 148 U/L。

note.zh-CN: 呕吐、严重代谢性酸中毒时淀粉酶常非特异性升高（部分为唾液型）；脂肪酶正常，不支持急性胰腺炎（诊断需满足以下3项中的2项：典型腹痛、脂肪酶/淀粉酶 > 3倍正常上限、典型影像学表现）。
note.en: Amylase is often raised non-specifically with vomiting and a severe metabolic acidosis (partly salivary); a normal lipase argues against acute pancreatitis (diagnosis needs two of: typical pain, lipase/amylase > 3× the upper limit, typical imaging).

text.zh-CN: 两套血培养（需氧 + 厌氧）已采集送检；培养进行中，本模拟时间范围内无阳性报警（最终报告需48小时以上）。

text.zh-CN: 床旁胸片（半坐位，AP位）：双肺野清晰，无实变、胸腔积液或气胸；心影大小正常；膈下未见游离气体。
text.en: Portable semi-erect chest X-ray (AP): clear lung fields, no consolidation, effusion or pneumothorax; normal heart size; no free gas under the diaphragm.

name.en: CT abdomen and pelvis with IV contrast

text.zh-CN: 腹盆腔增强CT：数段小肠腔内积液，肠壁无增厚，无梗阻征象，符合肠炎表现；阑尾正常；胰腺形态及密度正常，周围无渗出；无游离气体或积液；双肾、肝胆脾未见异常。
text.en: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast: a few fluid-filled small-bowel loops without wall thickening or obstruction, compatible with enteritis; normal appendix; normal pancreas without peripancreatic stranding; no free gas or collection; kidneys, liver, gallbladder and spleen normal.

note.zh-CN: 严重代谢性酸中毒引起的腹痛多随酸中毒纠正而缓解；脱水、肌酐升高时使用碘对比剂需权衡。通常仅在酸中毒纠正后腹痛仍持续或出现腹膜炎体征时才考虑影像学。
note.en: Abdominal pain caused by a severe metabolic acidosis usually settles as the acidosis is corrected; iodinated contrast during dehydration with a raised creatinine needs weighing. Imaging is usually reserved for pain that persists after the acidosis is corrected or for peritonism.

message.zh-CN: 提示：尿酮试纸只测乙酰乙酸，且滞后数小时；需要诊断或监测时请同时查血酮（β-羟丁酸）。
message.en: Note: urine ketone strips measure acetoacetate only and lag hours behind; to diagnose or monitor, check blood ketones (β-hydroxybutyrate).

name.zh-CN: 持续心电、血压、血氧监护
name.en: Continuous cardiac, BP and SpO₂ monitoring

response.zh-CN: 监护仪已连接：持续心电、无创血压（每15分钟）及血氧监测。
response.en: Monitor attached: continuous ECG, NIBP every 15 minutes and SpO₂.

name.zh-CN: 建立两条外周静脉通路并抽血
name.en: Two large-bore peripheral IV cannulae and bloods

dose.zh-CN: 双侧前臂各置18G留置针，同时抽血送检
dose.en: 18G cannula in each forearm; bloods drawn at the same time

response.zh-CN: 双侧前臂18G留置针已置入，血标本已留取。
response.en: 18G cannulae sited in both forearms; blood samples taken.

name.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠 1000 mL 静滴（1小时内）
name.en: 0.9% sodium chloride 1000 mL IV over 1 hour

dose.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠 1000 mL 静滴60分钟（约18 mL/kg）；不含钾（钾结果出来前）
dose.en: 0.9% NaCl 1000 mL IV over 60 minutes (about 18 mL/kg); no potassium (before the potassium result)

harm.zh-CN: 第一个小时已经给过1 L平衡晶体液，再快速输1 L属于过量补液；她只有24岁、55 kg，18–25岁年轻成人需谨慎补液并监测神经系统体征。
harm.en: She already had a litre of balanced crystalloid in the first hour; another rapid litre is excessive. She is 24 and 55 kg — young adults (18–25 y) need cautious fluid replacement and neurological observations.

response.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠1000 mL开始输注，计划60分钟输完。
response.en: 0.9% NaCl 1000 mL running, to finish over 60 minutes.

name.zh-CN: 平衡晶体液（如乳酸林格液/复方电解质）1000 mL 静滴（1小时内）
name.en: Balanced crystalloid (e.g. Hartmann's / Plasma-Lyte) 1000 mL IV over 1 hour

dose.zh-CN: 平衡晶体液 1000 mL 静滴60分钟（约18 mL/kg）
dose.en: Balanced crystalloid 1000 mL IV over 60 minutes (about 18 mL/kg)

harm.zh-CN: 第一个小时已经给过1 L生理盐水，再快速输1 L属于过量补液；18–25岁年轻成人需谨慎补液并监测神经系统体征。
harm.en: She already had a litre of 0.9% saline in the first hour; another rapid litre is excessive. Young adults (18–25 y) need cautious fluid replacement and neurological observations.

response.zh-CN: 平衡晶体液1000 mL开始输注，计划60分钟输完。（2024年国际共识认为平衡晶体液与0.9%氯化钠均可作为初始液体。）
response.en: Balanced crystalloid 1000 mL running over 60 minutes. (The 2024 international consensus accepts either balanced crystalloid or 0.9% saline as the initial fluid.)

name.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠 500 mL 快速推注（10–15分钟）
name.en: 0.9% sodium chloride 500 mL rapid bolus (10–15 minutes)

dose.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠 500 mL 静脉推注10–15分钟
dose.en: 0.9% NaCl 500 mL IV over 10–15 minutes

response.zh-CN: 500 mL快速推注完成。她的收缩压并不低于90 mmHg，按指南此时按计划速度补液即可，无需额外冲击。
response.en: 500 mL bolus given. Her systolic pressure is not below 90 mmHg, so guidelines advise scheduled-rate fluids rather than extra boluses.

dose.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠1000 mL + 氯化钾40 mmol（约3.0 g；预混袋，40 mmol/L），经第二条外周大静脉以500 mL/h泵入（= 氯化钾20 mmol/h，约1.5 g/h）；持续心电监护；每小时复查钾
dose.en: 0.9% NaCl 1000 mL with KCl 40 mmol (pre-mixed bag, 40 mmol/L) via the second large peripheral line at 500 mL/h (= KCl 20 mmol/h) on a volumetric pump; continuous ECG monitoring; recheck K⁺ hourly

harm.zh-CN: 还不知道血钾就开始以20 mmol/h补钾：若实际是高钾血症会致命。床旁血气5分钟内就能给出钾值——先测再补。
harm.en: Running potassium at 20 mmol/h without knowing the potassium could be fatal if she were hyperkalaemic. A bedside gas gives a potassium within 5 minutes — measure first.

response.zh-CN: 护士双人核对后，经第二条静脉通路以500 mL/h泵入含钾40 mmol/L的0.9%氯化钠（氯化钾20 mmol/h），胰岛素暂缓。
response.en: After a two-nurse check, 0.9% NaCl with KCl 40 mmol/L is running through the second line at 500 mL/h (KCl 20 mmol/h); insulin is on hold.

name.zh-CN: 后续补液：0.9%氯化钠 + 氯化钾40 mmol/L（按方案速度）
name.en: Ongoing fluids: 0.9% sodium chloride with KCl 40 mmol/L (protocol rate)

dose.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠1000 mL + 氯化钾40 mmol（约3.0 g），按方案依次2小时、4小时、4小时、6小时输完一袋；钾3.5–5.5 mmol/L时每升加40 mmol，钾 > 5.5时不加钾；每2小时复查钾
dose.en: 0.9% NaCl 1000 mL with KCl 40 mmol, each bag over 2 h, 4 h, 4 h, then 6 h per protocol; add 40 mmol/L while K⁺ is 3.5–5.5 mmol/L, none if K⁺ > 5.5; recheck K⁺ every 2 hours

harm.zh-CN: 不知道血钾就在补液中加钾：若实际是高钾血症会有危险。先测钾。
harm.en: Adding potassium to fluids without knowing the potassium is unsafe if she were hyperkalaemic. Measure it first.

response.zh-CN: 下一袋含钾0.9%氯化钠已按方案速度开始输注。
response.en: The next bag of 0.9% NaCl with potassium is running at the protocol rate.

name.zh-CN: 固定速率静脉胰岛素输注（0.1 U/kg/h）

dose.zh-CN: 普通（可溶性）人胰岛素50 U加0.9%氯化钠至50 mL（1 U/mL），按0.1 U/kg/h固定速率静脉泵入，不需负荷量
dose.en: Soluble (regular) human insulin 50 U made up to 50 mL with 0.9% NaCl (1 U/mL); fixed rate 0.1 U/kg/h IV, no bolus

harm.zh-CN: 血钾 < 3.5 mmol/L时开始胰岛素：胰岛素会把钾迅速驱入细胞内，可导致严重低钾血症、室性心律失常和呼吸肌无力。应先补钾，待钾 ≥ 3.5 mmol/L再开始胰岛素。
harm.en: Insulin started while K⁺ is < 3.5 mmol/L drives potassium into cells and can cause profound hypokalaemia, ventricular arrhythmias and respiratory-muscle weakness. Replace potassium first and start insulin only when K⁺ ≥ 3.5 mmol/L.

response.zh-CN: 胰岛素输注泵以5.5 mL/h（5.5 U/h，按她的体重55 kg × 0.1 U/kg/h）开始。护士：“我会每小时测指尖血糖和血酮。”
response.en: Insulin infusion started at 5.5 mL/h (5.5 U/h: 0.1 U/kg/h for her 55 kg). Nurse: "I'll check capillary glucose and ketones every hour."

name.zh-CN: 静脉推注胰岛素负荷量（0.1 U/kg）

dose.zh-CN: 普通胰岛素5.5 U静脉推注（0.1 U/kg）
dose.en: Soluble insulin 5.5 U IV bolus (0.1 U/kg)

harm.zh-CN: 血钾 < 3.5 mmol/L时推注胰岛素会使血钾进一步骤降，有致命性心律失常风险。即使钾正常，固定速率输注0.1 U/kg/h时也不需要负荷剂量。
harm.en: An insulin bolus while K⁺ is < 3.5 mmol/L drops the potassium further and risks fatal arrhythmia. Even with a normal potassium, no bolus is needed with a fixed-rate infusion of 0.1 U/kg/h.

response.zh-CN: 已推注胰岛素5.5 U。药师提醒：固定速率0.1 U/kg/h输注方案不需要负荷剂量，负荷量只会让血糖和血钾短时间内下降更快。
response.en: Insulin 5.5 U given IV. The pharmacist notes that a fixed-rate 0.1 U/kg/h regimen needs no bolus; a bolus only makes glucose and potassium fall faster for a short while.

name.zh-CN: 用患者自己的胰岛素泵（原管路）打校正剂量
name.en: Correction bolus through her own pump (existing set)

dose.zh-CN: 经原输注管路打校正大剂量
dose.en: Correction bolus through the existing infusion set

harm.zh-CN: 原管路已打折堵塞，泵立即再次“堵塞”报警，胰岛素根本输不进去；而且严重脱水、酸中毒时皮下吸收不可靠，血钾低时也不应先给胰岛素。应停用并取下泵，改用静脉胰岛素。
harm.en: The kinked set is occluded — the pump immediately alarms 'occlusion' again and no insulin is delivered. With severe dehydration and acidosis subcutaneous absorption is unreliable, and insulin must not come before potassium. Suspend and remove the pump and use IV insulin.

response.zh-CN: 泵屏幕再次显示“堵塞——停止输注”，未输入任何胰岛素。
response.en: The pump shows 'occlusion — delivery stopped' again; no insulin was delivered.

name.zh-CN: 暂停并取下胰岛素泵及输注管路
name.en: Suspend and remove the insulin pump and infusion set

dose.zh-CN: 暂停输注、拔除软管针、保留泵和管路以备下载数据；静脉胰岛素期间不使用泵
dose.en: Suspend delivery, remove the cannula, keep the pump and set for download; no pump use while on IV insulin

response.zh-CN: 泵已暂停并取下，软管针拔除，泵交给护士保管以备读取数据。拔出的软管尖端弯折。
response.en: Pump suspended and removed, cannula taken out; the pump is kept by the nurse for download. The removed cannula tip is bent.

dose.zh-CN: 8.4%碳酸氢钠100 mL（100 mmol）静滴30分钟
dose.en: 8.4% sodium bicarbonate 100 mL (100 mmol) IV over 30 minutes

harm.zh-CN: pH ≥ 7.0时不推荐补碱（共识仅在pH < 7.0时考虑）。碳酸氢钠会把钾驱入细胞内，加重本已存在的低钾血症；还可能延缓酮体清除、加重细胞内/脑脊液酸中毒并带来钠负荷。补液和胰岛素本身就能纠正酸中毒。
harm.en: Bicarbonate is not recommended when pH ≥ 7.0 (consensus considers it only below 7.0). It drives potassium into cells and worsens her existing hypokalaemia, may slow ketone clearance, can worsen intracellular/CSF acidosis and adds a sodium load. Fluids and insulin correct the acidosis.

response.zh-CN: 碳酸氢钠开始输注。
response.en: Sodium bicarbonate infusion started.

dose.zh-CN: 氯化钾20 mmol静脉推注
dose.en: KCl 20 mmol IV push

harm.zh-CN: 氯化钾绝对禁止静脉推注——可致心脏骤停（“永不事件”）。只能稀释后用输液泵控制速度输注（外周 ≤ 40 mmol/L，本例 ≤ 20 mmol/h并持续心电监护）。
harm.en: Potassium chloride must never be given as an IV push — it can cause cardiac arrest (a 'never event'). Give it only diluted and by volumetric pump (peripheral ≤ 40 mmol/L; here ≤ 20 mmol/h with continuous ECG monitoring).

response.zh-CN: 护士拒绝执行并立即上报：“氯化钾不能静推！我按补钾方案用输液泵给，好吗？”未给药。
response.en: The nurse refuses and escalates immediately: "Potassium can never be pushed! I'll give it by pump per the replacement protocol, OK?" Nothing was given.

dose.zh-CN: 磷酸钾（含磷20 mmol）加入补液中6小时以上输注
dose.en: Potassium phosphate (20 mmol phosphate) added to fluids over at least 6 hours

response.zh-CN: 已加入补液。说明：常规补磷未显示获益，且可致低钙血症；仅在磷 < 0.32 mmol/L（1.0 mg/dL）或伴心功能不全、贫血、呼吸抑制时考虑。除非血磷低于该阈值或出现上述情况，否则监测即可。
response.en: Added to the fluids. Note: routine phosphate replacement has shown no benefit and can cause hypocalcaemia; it is considered only if phosphate is < 0.32 mmol/L (1.0 mg/dL) or with cardiac dysfunction, anaemia or respiratory depression. Unless her phosphate is below that threshold or one of those applies, monitoring is enough.

dose.zh-CN: 昂丹司琼4 mg缓慢静注
dose.en: Ondansetron 4 mg slow IV

response.zh-CN: 已缓慢静注昂丹司琼4 mg，恶心有所减轻。药师提醒：低钾时QT/QU延长，应在心电监护下使用并尽快纠正低钾。
response.en: Ondansetron 4 mg given slowly IV; the nausea eases a little. The pharmacist notes QT/QU prolongation with low potassium: use on the monitor and correct the potassium promptly.

name.zh-CN: 经验性静脉抗生素（头孢曲松）

dose.zh-CN: 头孢曲松2 g静滴
dose.en: Ceftriaxone 2 g IV

response.zh-CN: 头孢曲松已开始输注。说明：应激和脱水时白细胞升高很常见，单凭白细胞增多不是使用抗生素的理由；只有当病史、查体或检查（尿、胸片、皮肤等）找到细菌感染灶，或出现脓毒症表现时，才需要经验性抗生素。
response.en: Ceftriaxone is running. Note: leucocytosis is common with stress and dehydration and is not by itself a reason for antibiotics; empirical antibiotics are needed only when history, examination or tests (urine, chest film, skin) identify a bacterial focus, or she shows signs of sepsis.

dose.zh-CN: 储氧面罩15 L/min
dose.en: Non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min

response.zh-CN: 已给氧。她的SpO₂吸空气时就是99%，呼吸急促是代谢性酸中毒的代偿（库斯莫尔呼吸），不是缺氧——吸氧不改善呼吸。
response.en: Oxygen applied. Her SpO₂ was already 99% on air; the fast breathing is respiratory compensation for metabolic acidosis (Kussmaul), not hypoxaemia — oxygen does not change it.

dose.zh-CN: 依诺肝素40 mg皮下注射，每日一次
dose.en: Enoxaparin 40 mg SC once daily

response.zh-CN: 依诺肝素40 mg已皮下注射。严重脱水和高血糖使血液处于高凝状态，卧床住院期间需评估血栓预防。
response.en: Enoxaparin 40 mg given SC. Severe dehydration and hyperglycaemia are prothrombotic, so VTE prophylaxis should be considered during the admission.

dose.zh-CN: Foley导尿管 + 精确尿量计
dose.en: Foley catheter with urometer

response.zh-CN: 已留置导尿。说明：她意识清楚、能自行排尿，这种情况并不常规需要导尿；只在无尿超过1小时、意识障碍或尿量难以监测时考虑，需权衡导管相关感染风险。
response.en: Catheter inserted. Note: she is alert and passing urine; a catheter is not routine here — consider them only for no urine after an hour, reduced consciousness or when output cannot be measured, and weigh the infection risk.

name.en: Set up the hourly monitoring plan

dose.zh-CN: 每小时指尖血糖与血酮；第1小时、第2小时及之后每2小时静脉血气（pH、HCO₃⁻、钾）——钾 < 3.5 mmol/L或以20 mmol/h补钾期间每小时复查钾；每小时生命体征及GCS（18–25岁需警惕脑水肿）；严格记录出入量（尿量 ≥ 0.5 mL/kg/h）。目标：血酮每小时下降 ≥ 0.5 mmol/L（无法测血酮时：HCO₃⁻每小时上升 ≥ 3 mmol/L），血糖每小时下降约3 mmol/L，钾维持在4.0–5.5 mmol/L。
dose.en: Hourly capillary glucose and ketones; venous gas (pH, HCO₃⁻, K⁺) at 1 h, 2 h and then 2-hourly — potassium hourly while it is < 3.5 mmol/L or KCl is running at 20 mmol/h; hourly observations including GCS (age 18–25: watch for cerebral oedema); strict fluid balance (urine ≥ 0.5 mL/kg/h). Targets: ketones falling ≥ 0.5 mmol/L/h (if ketones cannot be measured, HCO₃⁻ rising ≥ 3 mmol/L/h), glucose falling about 3 mmol/L/h, potassium kept at 4.0–5.5 mmol/L.

response.zh-CN: 监测方案已写入护理计划，护士确认按此执行。
response.en: The monitoring plan is in the nursing care plan and the nurse confirms it.

name.zh-CN: 请ICU/HDU会诊，安排高依赖病房（2级）监护
name.en: Refer to ICU/HDU for level-2 care

dose.zh-CN: 电话联系ICU/HDU值班医生，SBAR交接
dose.en: Phone the ICU/HDU registrar with an SBAR handover

response.zh-CN: ICU值班医生接受会诊：同意她需要2级（HDU）监护；HDU床位准备好之前在抢救室按HDU标准监护。
response.en: The ICU registrar accepts: agrees that she needs level-2 (HDU) care; until the HDU bed is ready she stays in resus with HDU-level monitoring.

name.en: Admit to a general medical ward

dose.zh-CN: 收入普通内科病房，常规护理
dose.en: Admit to a general medical ward, routine nursing

harm.zh-CN: 她病情危重，需要2级（HDU）监护和每小时监测（血糖、血酮、血气、电解质、神志、出入量），普通病房无法保证。请根据血气、血钾和生命体征判断所需的监护级别。
harm.en: She is critically unwell and needs level-2 (HDU) care with hourly monitoring (glucose, ketones, gas, electrolytes, neurological observations, fluid balance), which a general ward cannot provide. Judge the level of care from her gas, potassium and observations.

response.zh-CN: 已联系内科病房。
response.en: The medical ward has been contacted.

dose.zh-CN: 10%葡萄糖125 mL/h，与0.9%氯化钠（含钾）并行输注
dose.en: 10% glucose 125 mL/h alongside the 0.9% NaCl (with potassium)

response.zh-CN: 10%葡萄糖125 mL/h已开始。
response.en: 10% glucose at 125 mL/h started.

harm.zh-CN: 血糖仍 ≥ 14 mmol/L 时加葡萄糖只会加重高血糖和渗透性利尿。10%葡萄糖应在胰岛素治疗下血糖降到14 mmol/L以下时加用，以便继续全量胰岛素。
harm.en: Adding glucose while her glucose is still ≥ 14 mmol/L only worsens the hyperglycaemia and the osmotic diuresis. 10% glucose is added once glucose falls below 14 mmol/L on insulin, so that full-dose insulin can continue.

name.zh-CN: 低血糖处理：静注20%葡萄糖

dose.zh-CN: 20%葡萄糖75 mL（15 g）静注15分钟，10–15分钟后复测
dose.en: 20% glucose 75 mL (15 g) IV over 15 minutes, recheck in 10–15 minutes

harm.zh-CN: 血糖并不低时推注葡萄糖只会加重高血糖。
harm.en: Giving a glucose bolus when glucose is not low only worsens hyperglycaemia.

response.zh-CN: 20%葡萄糖75 mL已推注。
response.en: 20% glucose 75 mL given.

name.zh-CN: 皮下胰岛素（甘精胰岛素 + 门冬胰岛素）

dose.zh-CN: 与糖尿病专科商定：甘精胰岛素皮下注射，剂量约等于泵的每日基础总量（以她本人或泵数据下载所示为准），随第一餐按她的碳水系数皮下注射门冬胰岛素；暂不恢复胰岛素泵，待病愈并完成再教育后由专科安排换新管路重新上泵
dose.en: Agreed with the diabetes team: insulin glargine SC at about her pump's total daily basal dose (as she or the pump download reports it) and insulin aspart SC with her first meal by her carbohydrate ratio; the pump stays off until she is well and re-educated, then the team restarts it with a new set

response.zh-CN: 甘精胰岛素18 U已皮下注射；她进餐时注射了门冬胰岛素。静脉胰岛素继续输注，等待重叠时间。
response.en: Insulin glargine 18 U given SC; she has had aspart with her meal. The IV insulin keeps running for the overlap.

dose.zh-CN: 停用静脉胰岛素输注泵，同时停用10%葡萄糖
dose.en: Stop the IV insulin infusion together with the 10% glucose

harm.zh-CN: 在确认缓解之前、或还没有皮下胰岛素接续时就停静脉胰岛素：静脉胰岛素半衰期只有几分钟，她的泵也已取下，体内很快没有胰岛素，酮症会迅速反弹。
harm.en: Stopping IV insulin before resolution has been confirmed, or before subcutaneous insulin is on board: IV insulin lasts only minutes and her pump is off, so she is soon without insulin and ketosis rebounds quickly.

response.zh-CN: 静脉胰岛素和10%葡萄糖已停止。护士继续按计划监测血糖和血酮。
response.en: IV insulin and 10% glucose stopped. The nurse continues the planned glucose and ketone checks.

name.zh-CN: 请糖尿病专科（住院糖尿病团队）会诊
name.en: Refer to the inpatient diabetes team

dose.zh-CN: 24小时内专科评估：胰岛素泵故障处理与重新上泵计划、生病日规则（生病时不停基础胰岛素、每2–4小时测血糖和血酮、出现酮体用笔式胰岛素校正并更换管路）、配发血酮仪和试纸
dose.en: Specialist review within 24 hours: pump troubleshooting and restart plan, sick-day rules (never stop basal insulin when ill, check glucose and ketones every 2–4 hours, correct with a pen and change the set if ketones appear), and a blood-ketone meter with strips

response.zh-CN: 住院糖尿病团队已接收会诊，将于今天上午查看患者。
response.en: The inpatient diabetes team has accepted the referral and will see her this morning.

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生，她到现在还没有输上液体——血压在往下掉，嘴唇干得起皮了。”
message.en: Nurse: "Doctor, she still has no IV fluids running — her blood pressure is drifting down and her lips are cracked dry."

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生，胰岛素输注泵已按科室方案配好了（50单位配50毫升），现在就接上吗？”
message.en: Nurse: "Doctor, the insulin infusion is made up per our protocol — 50 units in 50 mL. Shall I connect it now?"

message.zh-CN: 护士：“到院已经半小时了，电解质您看过了吗？补液里要不要加钾，我等您的医嘱。”
message.en: Nurse: "She's been here half an hour — have you seen her electrolytes? I'm waiting for your order on potassium."

message.zh-CN: 护士：“胰岛素已经开始了……钾的结果确认过了吗？”
message.en: Nurse: "The insulin's going in now... has the potassium been checked?"

message.zh-CN: 监护报警：频发多源室性早搏，刚才一阵6跳短阵室速后自行终止！患者说心慌、两条腿发软没力气。护士急查床旁血气：K⁺ 2.6 mmol/L。
message.en: Monitor alarm: frequent multifocal ventricular ectopics, and a 6-beat run of ventricular tachycardia that stopped on its own! She says her heart is racing and her legs feel weak and heavy. The nurse runs an urgent bedside gas: K⁺ 2.6 mmol/L.

message.zh-CN: 护士：“补钾一段时间后，监护上的室性早搏明显少了，心率也降下来一些。”
message.en: Nurse: "Since the potassium has been running, the ectopics have settled and her heart rate has come down a bit."

message.zh-CN: 护士：“碳酸氢钠输上以后，监护上的室性早搏多了不少……”
message.en: Nurse: "Since the bicarbonate went up there are a lot more ectopics on the monitor..."

message.zh-CN: 护士：“补钾已经输了一段时间了，按方案该复查血气和血钾了。”
message.en: Nurse: "The potassium has been running for a while — per protocol it's time to recheck the gas and potassium."

message.zh-CN: 上级医生：“到院3小时了还没有开始胰岛素——现在卡在哪一步？”
message.en: Attending: "Three hours in and still no insulin running — what's holding it up?"

message.zh-CN: 护士：“这次指尖血糖已经降到14 mmol/L以下了。”
message.en: Nurse: "This hour's capillary glucose is below 14 mmol/L now."

message.zh-CN: 护士：“指尖血糖低于4了！她一身冷汗、手在发抖，说心慌。”
message.en: Nurse: "Capillary glucose is under 4! She's sweaty and shaky and says her heart is pounding."

message.zh-CN: 护士：“她出了一身冷汗，要大声叫她才睁眼，说话也含糊了——指尖血糖还在往下掉！”
message.en: Nurse: "She's drenched in sweat, only opens her eyes when I raise my voice and her speech is slurred — her capillary glucose is still falling!"

message.zh-CN: 护士：“血糖上来以后她清醒多了，对答也切题了。”
message.en: Nurse: "Now her glucose is back up she's properly awake and making sense again."

message.zh-CN: 护士：“她呼吸平稳多了，人也精神了，说肚子饿、想吃东西。”
message.en: Nurse: "Her breathing has settled and she's much brighter — she says she's hungry and wants something to eat."

message.zh-CN: 护士：“静脉胰岛素停了，可她还没打任何皮下胰岛素，泵也取下来了——她现在体内几乎没有胰岛素，酮症很快会反弹的！”
message.en: Nurse: "The IV insulin is off but she hasn't had any subcutaneous insulin, and her pump is off — she has almost no insulin on board now; the ketosis will rebound fast!"

hint.zh-CN: 她呼吸深快、精神萎靡：先上监护，问清起病经过、口渴多尿，看一眼整体情况和呼吸型态，再做一个床旁快速检测。
hint.en: She is breathing deeply and fast and looks exhausted: attach the monitor, establish the story and any thirst/polyuria, look at her and at her breathing pattern, and do a quick bedside test.

guidance.zh-CN: 走到抢救床旁：上监护、问诊、观察，并做床旁指尖检测。
guidance.en: Go to the resus bay: monitor, history, inspection, and a bedside finger-prick test.

title.zh-CN: 确立诊断并判断严重程度
title.en: Establish the diagnosis and its severity

hint.zh-CN: 诊断需要哪三项证据（血糖/糖尿病、酮体、酸中毒）？用静脉血气算阴离子间隙，看HCO₃⁻和钾；按“最差的那一项”判断严重程度，决定在哪一级病房治疗。
hint.en: Which three pieces of evidence make the diagnosis (glucose/diabetes, ketones, acidosis)? Use a venous gas to calculate the anion gap and look at the bicarbonate and potassium; grade severity by the worst parameter and decide what level of care she needs.

guidance.zh-CN: 查床旁血酮和静脉血气，在会诊板给出诊断与严重程度，并安排相应级别的监护。
guidance.en: Check bedside ketones and a venous gas, commit to a diagnosis and severity at the board, and arrange the right level of care.

title.zh-CN: 初始复苏与电解质安全

hint.zh-CN: 第一步永远是补液。在决定下一种药之前，先看钾是多少、心电图有没有改变——哪种治疗会让钾进一步下降？
hint.en: Fluids always come first. Before choosing the next drug, look at the potassium and the ECG — which treatment would drive the potassium down further?

guidance.zh-CN: 开始补液，读心电图，在会诊板回答药物顺序问题并执行。
guidance.en: Start fluids, read the ECG, answer the sequencing question at the board and act on it.

title.zh-CN: 确定性治疗、寻找诱因与监测

hint.zh-CN: 复查钾达标后再开始确定性治疗——剂量按体重计算。同时找出这次发作的诱因（她用的是什么给药装置？），并建立监测方案。
hint.en: Once the repeat potassium is adequate, start definitive treatment — dose it by weight. Meanwhile find out what triggered this episode (how is her insulin delivered?) and set up a monitoring plan.

guidance.zh-CN: 补钾一段时间后复查血气（可用“等待”推进时间），按体重开始治疗；检查她的给药装置，在会诊板回答诱因问题；写好监测方案。
guidance.en: After potassium has run for a while, recheck the gas (use 'wait' to let time pass), start weight-based treatment, inspect her delivery device, answer the precipitant question at the board and write the monitoring plan.

title.zh-CN: 随病情演变复评并调整治疗
title.en: Reassess and adjust treatment as she evolves

hint.zh-CN: 治疗有效时，哪一项指标会先恢复？那时还能停药吗？酮体和酸中毒还在的时候，怎样既继续治疗又避免低血糖？
hint.en: When treatment works, which number recovers first? Can treatment stop then? While ketones and acidosis persist, how do you continue treatment without causing hypoglycaemia?

guidance.zh-CN: 用“等待”推进时间，留意护士报告；复查血酮/血气，在会诊板回答并调整输液。
guidance.en: Use 'wait' and listen for the nurse's reports; recheck ketones/gas, answer at the board and adjust the infusions.

title.en: Confirm resolution and hand over safely

hint.zh-CN: “缓解”用哪几个指标判断？按现行共识和JBDS，血糖不是标准。停静脉治疗之前，必须先有什么接续上？谁需要参与她出院前的教育？
hint.en: Which measurements define resolution? Under the current consensus and JBDS, glucose is not one of them. What must be on board before IV treatment stops? Who should be involved in her education before discharge?

guidance.zh-CN: 复查血酮和静脉血气，在会诊板回答，然后按顺序过渡并请专科会诊。
guidance.en: Recheck ketones and a venous gas, answer at the board, then transition in the right order and involve the specialist team.

prompt.zh-CN: 综合病史、床旁检测和静脉血气，最准确的诊断与严重程度是？
prompt.en: Bringing together the history, bedside tests and venous gas, what is the most accurate diagnosis and severity?

need.zh-CN: 先读指尖血糖、床旁血酮和静脉血气。
need.en: Read the capillary glucose, bedside ketones and venous gas first.

text.zh-CN: 重度糖尿病酮症酸中毒（DKA）：血糖28.0 mmol/L、血β-羟丁酸5.8 mmol/L、静脉pH 7.08、HCO₃⁻ 7.0 mmol/L、阴离子间隙26；HCO₃⁻ < 10 mmol/L即为重度，需HDU/ICU（2级）监护
text.en: Severe diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): glucose 28.0 mmol/L, β-hydroxybutyrate 5.8 mmol/L, venous pH 7.08, HCO₃⁻ 7.0 mmol/L, anion gap 26; a bicarbonate < 10 mmol/L makes it severe — HDU/ICU (level-2) care

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。诊断三联：D（已知1型糖尿病，血糖28.0 mmol/L ≥ 11.1）、K（β-羟丁酸5.8 ≥ 3.0 mmol/L）、A（pH 7.08 < 7.3，HCO₃⁻ 7.0 < 18）。阴离子间隙 = 131 −（98 + 7）= 26。严重程度按最差的指标判断：按ADA分级（Kitabchi 2009）HCO₃⁻ < 10为重度；JBDS提示需2级监护的指标还有入院时钾 < 3.5、心率 > 100、阴离子间隙 > 16。
feedback.en: Correct. D (known type 1 diabetes, glucose 28.0 ≥ 11.1 mmol/L), K (β-hydroxybutyrate 5.8 ≥ 3.0 mmol/L), A (pH 7.08 < 7.3, HCO₃⁻ 7.0 < 18). Anion gap = 131 − (98 + 7) = 26. Grade by the worst parameter: on the ADA grading (Kitabchi 2009) HCO₃⁻ < 10 is severe, and the JBDS level-2 markers also include admission K⁺ < 3.5, HR > 100 and anion gap > 16.

text.zh-CN: 中度DKA（pH在7.00–7.24之间），收入普通病房即可
text.en: Moderate DKA (pH between 7.00 and 7.24) — a general ward is fine

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。只看pH会低估严重程度。HCO₃⁻ 7.0 mmol/L（< 10）已属重度；再加上入院时低钾、心动过速、阴离子间隙26，她需要2级（HDU）监护和每小时监测。
feedback.en: No. Looking at pH alone underestimates her. HCO₃⁻ 7.0 mmol/L (< 10) is severe, and with admission hypokalaemia, tachycardia and an anion gap of 26 she needs level-2 (HDU) care with hourly monitoring.

text.zh-CN: 高血糖高渗状态（HHS）
text.en: Hyperosmolar hyperglycaemic state (HHS)

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。有效渗透压 = 2 × 131 + 28 = 290 mOsm/kg，计算总渗透压299，均低于HHS阈值（2024年共识：有效渗透压 > 300或总渗透压 > 320；JBDS及中国2013指南：≥ 320）；血糖未达HHS的 ≥ 33.3 mmol/L；且有明显酮血症和重度酸中毒。
feedback.en: No. Effective osmolality = 2 × 131 + 28 = 290 mOsm/kg and total calculated 299 — both below the HHS thresholds (2024 consensus: effective > 300 or total > 320; JBDS and the Chinese 2013 guideline: ≥ 320); glucose is below the ≥ 33.3 mmol/L of HHS; and she has marked ketonaemia with severe acidosis.

text.zh-CN: DKA与HHS混合型
text.en: Mixed DKA–HHS

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。混合型需要同时满足HHS的高渗标准（有效渗透压 ≥ 300–320 mOsm/kg），她的有效渗透压只有290。
feedback.en: No. A mixed picture needs the hyperosmolar criteria of HHS as well (effective osmolality ≥ 300–320 mOsm/kg); hers is only 290.

text.zh-CN: 饥饿性/酒精性酮症酸中毒
text.en: Starvation or alcoholic ketoacidosis

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。这两种情况血糖通常正常或偏低，饥饿性酮症的HCO₃⁻很少 < 18；她血糖28.0 mmol/L、已知1型糖尿病、几乎不饮酒。
feedback.en: No. In both, glucose is usually normal or low, and starvation ketosis rarely drops the bicarbonate below 18; she has a glucose of 28.0 mmol/L, known type 1 diabetes and drinks very little.

text.zh-CN: 正常血糖性DKA（SGLT2抑制剂相关）
text.en: Euglycaemic DKA (SGLT2-inhibitor related)

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。正常血糖性DKA指血糖 < 13.9 mmol/L（250 mg/dL）的DKA，常与SGLT2抑制剂、妊娠或饥饿有关；她血糖28.0 mmol/L且从未用过SGLT2抑制剂。
feedback.en: No. Euglycaemic DKA means DKA with glucose < 13.9 mmol/L (250 mg/dL), often with SGLT2 inhibitors, pregnancy or starvation; her glucose is 28.0 mmol/L and she has never taken an SGLT2 inhibitor.

text.zh-CN: 胃肠炎致脓毒症伴乳酸性酸中毒
text.en: Sepsis from gastroenteritis with lactic acidosis

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。乳酸仅2.1 mmol/L，远不能解释阴离子间隙26；高酮血症（β-羟丁酸5.8）才是主要的未测阴离子。
feedback.en: No. A lactate of 2.1 mmol/L cannot explain an anion gap of 26; the ketonaemia (β-hydroxybutyrate 5.8) accounts for the unmeasured anions.

prompt.zh-CN: 第一升液体正在输注，入院血钾3.2 mmol/L。关于钾和胰岛素，下一步最恰当的是？
prompt.en: The first litre of fluid is running and the admission potassium is 3.2 mmol/L. Regarding potassium and insulin, what is the most appropriate next step?

need.zh-CN: 先读到入院时的血钾（静脉血气或生化）。
need.en: Read the admission potassium first (venous gas or chemistry).

text.zh-CN: 暂缓胰岛素；继续补液并静脉补钾10–20 mmol/h（本例：含钾40 mmol/L的0.9%氯化钠以500 mL/h泵入 = 20 mmol/h，持续心电监护），每小时复查钾；钾 ≥ 3.5 mmol/L后开始固定速率胰岛素0.1 U/kg/h
text.en: Hold insulin; continue fluids and give IV potassium 10–20 mmol/h (here 0.9% NaCl with KCl 40 mmol/L at 500 mL/h = 20 mmol/h, on continuous ECG monitoring), recheck K⁺ hourly; start fixed-rate insulin 0.1 U/kg/h once K⁺ ≥ 3.5 mmol/L

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。DKA时机体总钾严重缺乏，酸中毒和胰岛素缺乏掩盖了这一点；入院钾已低于3.5提示缺钾很重。胰岛素会把钾驱入细胞内，先给胰岛素可致严重低钾、室性心律失常和呼吸肌无力。
feedback.en: Correct. Total-body potassium is profoundly depleted in DKA and acidosis plus insulin deficiency mask it; an admission K⁺ already below 3.5 signals a large deficit. Insulin drives potassium into cells, so insulin first risks severe hypokalaemia, ventricular arrhythmia and respiratory-muscle weakness.

text.zh-CN: 现在就开始固定速率胰岛素0.1 U/kg/h，下一袋液体里再加钾
text.en: Start fixed-rate insulin 0.1 U/kg/h now and add potassium to the next bag

feedback.zh-CN: 不安全。钾 < 3.5 mmol/L时开始胰岛素会使钾进一步骤降。补液本身就能降低血糖，推迟胰岛素1小时左右没有害处，低钾性心律失常却可能致命。
feedback.en: Unsafe. Starting insulin with K⁺ < 3.5 mmol/L makes it plunge further. Fluids alone already lower glucose; delaying insulin for about an hour does no harm, whereas a hypokalaemic arrhythmia can kill.

text.zh-CN: 先静推胰岛素0.1 U/kg负荷量再持续输注，尽快清除酮体
text.en: Give an IV insulin bolus of 0.1 U/kg then an infusion, to clear ketones fast

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。同样是在低钾时给胰岛素，而且负荷量会让钾下降得更快；固定速率0.1 U/kg/h方案本身不需要负荷量。
feedback.en: No. This still gives insulin while hypokalaemic, and the bolus makes the potassium fall faster; a fixed-rate 0.1 U/kg/h regimen needs no bolus.

text.zh-CN: 先给碳酸氢钠纠正酸中毒，再开始胰岛素
text.en: Correct the acidosis with sodium bicarbonate first, then start insulin

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。pH ≥ 7.0不推荐补碱，而且碳酸氢钠同样会把钾驱入细胞内，加重低钾。
feedback.en: No. Bicarbonate is not recommended when pH ≥ 7.0, and it also drives potassium into cells, worsening the hypokalaemia.

text.zh-CN: 立即静推氯化钾20 mmol，然后开始胰岛素
text.en: Push KCl 20 mmol IV now, then start insulin

feedback.zh-CN: 绝对禁止。氯化钾静推可致心脏骤停（永不事件）；钾只能稀释后用输液泵控速输注。
feedback.en: Never. An IV push of potassium can cause cardiac arrest (a never event); potassium is only ever given diluted by volumetric pump.

text.zh-CN: 等45分钟后生化室的正式钾结果出来再决定
text.en: Wait 45 minutes for the formal laboratory potassium before deciding

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。血气分析仪的钾足以指导治疗（本例心电图的U波也印证了低钾）；应现在就开始补钾，生化结果用于核对。
feedback.en: No. The blood-gas potassium is good enough to act on (here the ECG U waves corroborate it); start replacing now and use the lab value to confirm.

prompt.zh-CN: 这次发作的诱因是什么？选择所有有证据支持的选项。
prompt.en: What precipitated this episode? Select every option the evidence supports.

need.zh-CN: 先询问胰岛素泵的情况并检查泵或下载泵数据，读尿妊娠试验和脂肪酶结果。
need.en: Ask about her pump and inspect it or download it, and read the pregnancy test and lipase.

text.zh-CN: 胰岛素输注中断：泵管路打折堵塞（反复“堵塞”报警被清除、管路超期使用4天）
text.en: Interrupted insulin delivery: kinked, occluded pump set (repeated 'occlusion' alarms cleared; set 4 days old)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。胰岛素泵只输注速效胰岛素，体内没有长效胰岛素储备，输注中断后数小时内就可发生酮症酸中毒。
feedback.en: Correct. A pump delivers only rapid-acting insulin, so there is no long-acting depot — ketoacidosis can develop within hours of interrupted delivery.

text.zh-CN: 生病时自行停打餐时/校正胰岛素（对生病日规则的误解）
text.en: Omitting meal and correction insulin during illness (a misunderstanding of sick-day rules)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。“不吃饭就不用胰岛素”是常见误区；生病时胰岛素需求往往增加，必须继续基础胰岛素并按血糖和血酮追加校正剂量。
feedback.en: Correct. 'No food, no insulin' is a common misconception; illness usually raises insulin needs — basal insulin must continue, with corrections guided by glucose and ketones.

text.zh-CN: 并发急性胃肠炎（很可能为病毒性，室友有类似病史）
text.en: Intercurrent acute gastroenteritis (probably viral; her roommate had a similar illness)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。感染应激增加胰岛素需求，呕吐腹泻加重脱水，并让她误以为不需要胰岛素。
feedback.en: Correct. Illness stress increases insulin requirements, vomiting and diarrhoea worsen dehydration, and it led her to think she needed no insulin.

text.zh-CN: 急性胰腺炎
text.en: Acute pancreatitis

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。脂肪酶正常（42 U/L）；DKA时淀粉酶常非特异性升高，腹痛也常随酸中毒纠正而缓解。
feedback.en: No. Lipase is normal (42 U/L); amylase is often non-specifically raised in DKA, and the abdominal pain usually settles as the acidosis is corrected.

text.zh-CN: 妊娠
text.en: Pregnancy

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。尿hCG阴性。育龄女性仍必须常规检查，因为妊娠可诱发DKA并改变用药选择。
feedback.en: No. Urine hCG is negative — but it must always be checked in women of reproductive age, because pregnancy can precipitate DKA and changes drug choices.

text.zh-CN: 尿路感染/肾盂肾炎
text.en: Urinary tract infection / pyelonephritis

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。无尿痛、无肾区叩痛，尿白细胞酯酶和亚硝酸盐阴性，镜检无白细胞和细菌。
feedback.en: No. No dysuria, no renal-angle tenderness, and the urine is negative for leucocyte esterase and nitrite with no white cells or organisms on microscopy.

text.zh-CN: SGLT2抑制剂
text.en: SGLT2 inhibitor

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她只用胰岛素，从未使用SGLT2抑制剂。
feedback.en: No. She uses only insulin and has never taken an SGLT2 inhibitor.

prompt.zh-CN: 她的指尖血糖已降到14 mmol/L以下，但血酮仍升高、酸中毒尚未纠正。现在最恰当的处理是？
prompt.en: Her capillary glucose has fallen below 14 mmol/L, but ketones are still raised and the acidosis has not cleared. What is the most appropriate step now?

need.zh-CN: 等血糖降到14 mmol/L以下，并在此时复查血酮或静脉血气。
need.en: Wait until glucose is below 14 mmol/L and recheck ketones or a venous gas at that point.

text.zh-CN: 继续胰岛素0.1 U/kg/h，同时加用10%葡萄糖125 mL/h（与含钾0.9%氯化钠并行），维持血糖约10–14 mmol/L
text.en: Continue insulin at 0.1 U/kg/h and add 10% glucose 125 mL/h alongside the 0.9% NaCl with potassium, keeping glucose about 10–14 mmol/L

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。胰岛素是用来清除酮体、纠正酸中毒的，血糖下降得比酮体快；加葡萄糖是为了能继续足量胰岛素而不发生低血糖。（ADA 2009及中国2013指南的做法是在血糖约11.1 mmol/L时把胰岛素减至0.02–0.05 U/kg/h，并同时补葡萄糖——同样是加糖、不停胰岛素。）
feedback.en: Correct. Insulin is there to switch off ketogenesis and clear the acidosis, and glucose falls faster than ketones; the glucose lets full-dose insulin continue without hypoglycaemia. (Older ADA 2009 and Chinese 2013 protocols instead reduce insulin to 0.02–0.05 U/kg/h once glucose reaches about 11.1 mmol/L — always together with glucose, never instead of it.)

text.zh-CN: 血糖已接近正常，停用胰岛素
text.en: Glucose is nearly normal — stop the insulin

feedback.zh-CN: 危险。血酮仍高、pH和HCO₃⁻仍低；停胰岛素会让酮症酸中毒迅速反弹。
feedback.en: Dangerous. Ketones are still high and pH and bicarbonate still low; stopping insulin lets the ketoacidosis rebound quickly.

text.zh-CN: 现在就改为皮下胰岛素
text.en: Switch to subcutaneous insulin now

feedback.zh-CN: 过早。DKA尚未缓解（血酮仍 ≥ 0.6 mmol/L、pH ≤ 7.3），也还没有恢复进食；应继续静脉胰岛素。
feedback.en: Too early. The DKA has not resolved (ketones still ≥ 0.6 mmol/L, pH ≤ 7.3) and she is not eating yet; keep the IV insulin going.

text.zh-CN: 把胰岛素减到0.02 U/kg/h，不加葡萄糖
text.en: Cut insulin to 0.02 U/kg/h and add no glucose

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。只减胰岛素、不加葡萄糖，是拿酮体清除去换血糖：酮体生成抑制不足，酸中毒纠正明显延迟。JBDS维持0.1 U/kg/h并加10%葡萄糖；较早的ADA/中国方案把胰岛素减到0.02–0.05 U/kg/h时也必须同时补葡萄糖。
feedback.en: No. Cutting insulin without adding glucose trades ketone clearance for glucose control: ketogenesis is suppressed less and clearing the acidosis is delayed. JBDS keeps 0.1 U/kg/h and adds 10% glucose; the older ADA/Chinese protocols that drop to 0.02–0.05 U/kg/h always add glucose at the same time.

text.zh-CN: 维持原方案不变，4小时后再复查
text.en: Carry on unchanged and recheck in 4 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 不安全。血糖仍在每小时约3–4 mmol/L地下降，不加葡萄糖几小时内就会低血糖；监测也应该每小时一次。
feedback.en: Unsafe. Glucose is still falling about 3–4 mmol/L per hour, so without glucose she will be hypoglycaemic within hours; and monitoring should be hourly.

prompt.zh-CN: 复查结果出来了。她的DKA是否已缓解？停用静脉胰岛素之前需要满足或完成哪些？选择所有正确项。
prompt.en: The repeat results are back. Has her DKA resolved, and what must be true or done before the IV insulin stops? Select all that apply.

need.zh-CN: 先复查并读取血酮和静脉血气。
need.en: Recheck and read the blood ketones and a venous gas first.

text.zh-CN: 已缓解：血β-羟丁酸0.2 mmol/L（< 0.6），静脉pH 7.35（> 7.3），HCO₃⁻ 19 mmol/L（≥ 18），阴离子间隙11
text.en: Resolved: β-hydroxybutyrate 0.2 mmol/L (< 0.6), venous pH 7.35 (> 7.3), HCO₃⁻ 19 mmol/L (≥ 18), anion gap 11

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。2024年国际共识：血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L且静脉pH ≥ 7.3或HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18 mmol/L；JBDS：血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L且静脉pH > 7.3。这两部指南都不用血糖判断缓解（输注葡萄糖期间，血糖反映的是补糖速度而不是酮症）。中国2013指南的参考标准更严（血酮 < 0.3 mmol/L、HCO₃⁻ ≥ 15 mmol/L、pH > 7.3、阴离子间隙 ≤ 12，另列血糖 < 11.1 mmol/L）；她的酮体和酸碱指标同样全部达标。
feedback.en: Correct. 2024 consensus: ketones < 0.6 mmol/L and venous pH ≥ 7.3 or HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18 mmol/L; JBDS: ketones < 0.6 mmol/L and venous pH > 7.3. Neither uses glucose to define resolution (while dextrose is running, glucose reflects the infusion, not the ketosis). The Chinese 2013 guideline lists stricter reference criteria (ketones < 0.3 mmol/L, HCO₃⁻ ≥ 15 mmol/L, pH > 7.3, anion gap ≤ 12, plus glucose < 11.1 mmol/L); her ketone and acid–base values meet those as well.

text.zh-CN: 她神志清楚、恶心已缓解，能够进食进水
text.en: She is alert, the nausea has settled and she can eat and drink

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。能进食是过渡到皮下（餐时）胰岛素的前提。
feedback.en: Correct. Being able to eat is a prerequisite for moving to subcutaneous meal-time insulin.

text.zh-CN: 先皮下注射胰岛素（长效基础 + 随餐速效），静脉胰岛素继续重叠1–2小时后再停
text.en: Give subcutaneous insulin first (long-acting basal + rapid-acting with a meal) and keep the IV insulin running for a 1–2 h overlap before stopping it

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。静脉胰岛素作用只持续几分钟，没有皮下胰岛素接续就停会导致酮症反弹；她的泵已取下，没有任何胰岛素储备。
feedback.en: Correct. IV insulin lasts only minutes; stopping it with no subcutaneous insulin on board lets ketosis rebound — and her pump is off, so she has no other insulin.

text.zh-CN: 出院前由糖尿病专科评估：泵故障处理、生病日规则、配血酮仪和试纸
text.en: Diabetes-team review before discharge: pump troubleshooting, sick-day rules, a blood-ketone meter and strips

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。JBDS建议所有DKA患者由糖尿病专科团队评估，以找出可预防的原因、防止复发。
feedback.en: Correct. JBDS advises diabetes-specialist review for everyone with DKA, to address preventable causes and prevent recurrence.

text.zh-CN: 只要血糖 < 11 mmol/L就算缓解
text.en: Glucose < 11 mmol/L alone means resolution

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。血糖比酮体恢复得早得多；缓解看血酮和酸碱指标。
feedback.en: No. Glucose normalises long before ketones; resolution is judged on ketones and acid–base status.

text.zh-CN: 先停静脉胰岛素，等她下一餐时再打皮下胰岛素
text.en: Stop the IV insulin first and give subcutaneous insulin at her next meal

feedback.zh-CN: 危险。中间会出现没有胰岛素的空窗期，DKA可在数小时内复发。
feedback.en: Dangerous. It leaves a gap with no insulin, and DKA can recur within hours.

text.zh-CN: HCO₃⁻ 19仍偏低，继续静脉胰岛素直到HCO₃⁻ > 22
text.en: HCO₃⁻ 19 is still low — continue IV insulin until it is > 22

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。此时阴离子间隙已正常（11），残余的低HCO₃⁻主要是大量0.9%氯化钠导致的高氯性酸中毒（Cl⁻ 108），不是酮症，继续胰岛素无益。
feedback.en: No. The anion gap is now normal (11); the residual low bicarbonate is mainly hyperchloraemic acidosis from large volumes of 0.9% saline (Cl⁻ 108), not ketosis — more insulin will not help.

text.zh-CN: 询问出胰岛素泵故障和生病期间漏打胰岛素
text.en: Elicited the pump failure and the insulin omitted during illness

text.zh-CN: 询问过敏史、用药史及妊娠可能
text.en: Asked about allergies, medications and possible pregnancy

text.zh-CN: 评估呼吸型态、容量状态、腹部，并检查胰岛素泵及输注部位
text.en: Assessed breathing pattern, hydration and abdomen, and inspected the pump and infusion site

text.zh-CN: 到院15分钟内读到指尖血糖、血酮和静脉血气（含钾）
text.en: Had capillary glucose, blood ketones and a venous gas (with potassium) read within 15 minutes of arrival

text.zh-CN: 读心电图（低钾改变）并完成妊娠试验
text.en: Read the ECG (hypokalaemic changes) and checked a pregnancy test

text.zh-CN: 首次即正确判断诊断与严重程度，并正确找出诱因
text.en: Got the diagnosis and severity right first time and identified the precipitants

text.zh-CN: 到院30分钟内开始第一升等渗晶体液
text.en: Started the first litre of isotonic crystalloid within 30 minutes

text.zh-CN: 先补钾、钾 ≥ 3.5 mmol/L后才开始胰岛素
text.en: Replaced potassium first and started insulin only once K⁺ ≥ 3.5 mmol/L

text.zh-CN: 固定速率静脉胰岛素0.1 U/kg/h，未使用负荷剂量
text.en: Fixed-rate IV insulin at 0.1 U/kg/h without a bolus

text.zh-CN: 血糖 < 14 mmol/L时加葡萄糖并继续胰岛素，未发生低血糖
text.en: Added glucose with insulin continued when glucose fell below 14 mmol/L, with no hypoglycaemia

text.zh-CN: 安排2级（HDU）监护并建立每小时监测方案
text.en: Arranged level-2 (HDU) care and an hourly monitoring plan

text.zh-CN: 未使用碳酸氢钠，未静推氯化钾，未经原泵管路给胰岛素
text.en: No bicarbonate, no IV potassium push, no insulin through the old pump set

text.zh-CN: 缓解后先给皮下胰岛素、重叠后再停静脉胰岛素，并请糖尿病专科
text.en: After resolution gave subcutaneous insulin before stopping the IV insulin, and involved the diabetes team

text.zh-CN: 避免低价值检查和不必要的抗生素（动脉血气、腹部CT、经验性抗生素）
text.en: Avoided low-value tests and unnecessary antibiotics (ABG, abdominal CT, empirical antibiotics)

text.zh-CN: 向患者解释病情且不责备，回应她的担忧，进行生病日规则教育；向HDU/专科做结构化交接
text.en: Explained the illness without blame, addressed her concerns, taught sick-day rules, and gave a structured handover to HDU/the specialist team

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用通俗语言解释：胰岛素输注中断 + 生病时停打胰岛素 → 酮症酸中毒；明确“不是你的错，但我们可以一起防止再次发生”；回应论文答辩和胰岛素泵的担忧；生病日规则要点（生病不停基础胰岛素、每2–4小时测血糖和血酮、血酮 ≥ 0.6且血糖高时用笔式胰岛素校正并更换管路、无法进食进水或呕吐不止时立即就医）。交接（SBAR）包括：诊断与严重程度、入院钾3.2和先补钾的顺序、胰岛素开始时间和速率、已输液体量、当前血糖/血酮/血气趋势、监测方案和下一步计划；用药医嘱采用复述确认。
judgeGuidance.en: Plain-language explanation: interrupted pump delivery plus stopping insulin while ill → ketoacidosis; 'this is not your fault, but we can stop it happening again together'; addresses the thesis and pump worries; sick-day rules (never stop basal insulin when ill, check glucose and ketones every 2–4 hours, correct with a pen and change the set if ketones ≥ 0.6 with high glucose, seek help if unable to keep fluids down). SBAR handover covers diagnosis and severity, the admission K⁺ of 3.2 and potassium-first sequencing, insulin start time and rate, fluid given, current glucose/ketone/gas trends, the monitoring plan and next steps; drug orders are read back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 交班：24岁女性，02:40由室友打车送来，诉呕吐、腹痛约2天，今夜呼吸加快；直接进抢救室3床。分诊生命体征与到院时监护一致。到院前未用任何药，尚无静脉通路，尚未测指尖血糖。患者腰间别着一个胰岛素泵（护士能看到，但不解读其意义）。室友在家属等候区，可以联系患者家人。物流：床旁有监护仪、血糖/血酮仪、心电图机、输液泵、氧气；血气约5分钟出结果。急诊备药：0.9%氯化钠、平衡晶体液、预混含钾0.9%氯化钠（40 mmol/L）、10%和20%葡萄糖、普通胰岛素、甘精胰岛素、门冬胰岛素、昂丹司琼、8.4%碳酸氢钠、磷酸钾、头孢曲松、依诺肝素。护理常规：氯化钾只能稀释后用输液泵输注，外周浓度 ≤ 40 mmol/L，> 10 mmol/h需持续心电监护，绝不静推；胰岛素输注按医嘱配制（50 U/50 mL）。会主动提醒：到院30分钟仍未补钾、血糖降到14以下、低血糖、需要复查时。不解读化验结果，不给出诊断。
knowledge.en: Handover: 24-year-old woman brought by her roommate by taxi at 02:40 with about 2 days of vomiting and abdominal pain and faster breathing tonight; taken straight to resus bay 3. Triage vital signs match the monitor at arrival. No medicines before arrival, no IV access yet, capillary glucose not yet checked. She has an insulin pump clipped to her waistband (the nurse can see it but does not interpret it). The roommate is in the relatives' room and can contact the family. Logistics: the bay has a monitor, glucose/ketone meter, ECG cart, infusion pumps and oxygen; blood-gas results come back in about 5 minutes. ED stock: 0.9% NaCl, balanced crystalloid, pre-mixed 0.9% NaCl with KCl 40 mmol/L, 10% and 20% glucose, soluble insulin, glargine, aspart, ondansetron, 8.4% sodium bicarbonate, potassium phosphate, ceftriaxone, enoxaparin. Nursing rules: potassium only diluted by volumetric pump, peripheral concentration ≤ 40 mmol/L, > 10 mmol/h only on continuous ECG monitoring, never pushed; insulin infusions made up to order (50 U/50 mL). Speaks up when: no potassium order 30 minutes after arrival, glucose falls below 14, hypoglycaemia, or a recheck is due. Does not interpret results or suggest diagnoses.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只在学员打电话会诊时出现；先请学员汇报诊断、严重程度和已有结果，不替学员下诊断。接受急诊会诊电话；HDU床位约1小时后可用，在此之前在抢救室按HDU标准监护。只解读学员已经看过的静脉血气、生化和心电图。熟悉JBDS提示需2级监护的指标（血酮 > 6 mmol/L、HCO₃⁻ < 5 mmol/L、静脉pH < 7.0、入院时钾 < 3.5 mmol/L、GCS < 12、吸空气SpO₂ < 92%、收缩压 < 90 mmHg、心率 > 100或 < 60次/分、阴离子间隙 > 16）。会追问补钾与胰岛素的顺序、液体速度，并提醒18–25岁年轻成人需监测神经系统体征（脑水肿）。
knowledge.en: Comes in only when the learner phones the referral; first asks the learner to present their diagnosis, severity and results, and never makes the diagnosis for them. Takes the ED referral call; an HDU bed will be free in about an hour, and until then she stays in resus with HDU-level monitoring. Interprets only the venous gas, chemistry and ECG the learner has already seen. Knows the JBDS markers for level-2 care (ketones > 6 mmol/L, HCO₃⁻ < 5 mmol/L, venous pH < 7.0, admission K⁺ < 3.5 mmol/L, GCS < 12, SpO₂ < 92% on air, systolic BP < 90 mmHg, HR > 100 or < 60/min, anion gap > 16). Probes the potassium-before-insulin sequence and fluid rates, and reminds that young adults aged 18–25 need neurological observations (cerebral oedema).

name.zh-CN: 孙护士长（住院糖尿病专科护士）

knowledge.zh-CN: 只在学员提出会诊后出现，不先于学员说出诊断。白天接受会诊。只解读学员已经读过的泵下载数据和HbA1c。能讲解：胰岛素泵只用速效胰岛素、没有长效储备，输注中断数小时即可发生DKA；“不明原因高血糖 > 14 mmol/L先测血酮，血酮 ≥ 0.6时用笔式胰岛素校正并更换整套管路和部位”；生病日规则；建议从泵转为皮下基础—餐时方案时，甘精胰岛素剂量约等于泵的每日基础总量（她为18 U），餐时按碳水系数1 U:10 g；病愈且完成再教育后再换新管路重新上泵；出院前配发血酮仪和试纸并安排复诊。
knowledge.en: Comes in only once the learner refers her, and never names the diagnosis before the learner has. Available in the daytime. Interprets only the pump download and HbA1c that the learner has already read. Can explain that a pump delivers only rapid-acting insulin with no long-acting depot, so DKA can follow within hours of interrupted delivery; 'unexplained glucose > 14 mmol/L → check ketones; if ≥ 0.6, correct with a pen and change the whole set and site'; sick-day rules; that when moving from pump to SC basal–bolus the glargine dose is about the pump's total daily basal (18 U for her) with meal insulin by her 1 U:10 g ratio; that the pump is restarted with a new set once she is well and re-educated; and that she leaves with a blood-ketone meter, strips and follow-up.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只核对学员提出或已下达的药物与剂量，不主动给出治疗方案。核对剂量：固定速率胰岛素0.1 U/kg/h × 55 kg = 5.5 U/h（50 U/50 mL时5.5 mL/h），不需要负荷量；外周补钾浓度 ≤ 40 mmol/L、速度 ≤ 20 mmol/h需心电监护；氯化钾绝不静推；pH ≥ 7.0不推荐碳酸氢钠；磷 < 0.32 mmol/L才考虑补磷；依诺肝素40 mg每日一次适用于她的体重和肾功能；昂丹司琼在低钾、QT延长时需谨慎；左甲状腺素可在能口服后恢复。不做诊断。
knowledge.en: Checks only drugs and doses the learner proposes or has ordered, and does not volunteer a treatment plan. Checks doses: fixed-rate insulin 0.1 U/kg/h × 55 kg = 5.5 U/h (5.5 mL/h of 50 U/50 mL), no bolus; peripheral potassium ≤ 40 mmol/L and ≤ 20 mmol/h on ECG monitoring; potassium chloride is never pushed; bicarbonate is not recommended when pH ≥ 7.0; phosphate is replaced only below 0.32 mmol/L; enoxaparin 40 mg daily suits her weight and renal function; ondansetron needs care with hypokalaemia and a long QT; levothyroxine restarts once she can take oral medicines. Does not make diagnoses.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已经看过的胸片和腹部CT。会提醒：伴呕吐的严重代谢性酸中毒常引起腹痛，多随酸中毒纠正而缓解，脱水、肌酐升高时碘对比剂需权衡；纠正后腹痛仍持续或有腹膜炎体征时再考虑影像。不说出潜在诊断。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the chest X-ray and abdominal CT the learner has already seen. Points out that abdominal pain is common with a severe metabolic acidosis and vomiting and usually settles as the acidosis is corrected, that iodinated contrast during dehydration with a raised creatinine needs weighing, and that imaging is for pain that persists after correction or for peritonism. Does not name the underlying diagnosis.

name.zh-CN: 马主任（急诊科主治/上级医生）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，不直接给答案，只基于学员已获得的信息提问。学员确立诊断之前：深大呼吸可能在代偿什么？床旁马上能查什么？静脉血气怎么解读、阴离子间隙是多少？学员确立诊断之后：测得的钠为什么偏低、校正后是多少？严重程度按哪个指标判断？为什么不能先给胰岛素？什么时候才考虑碳酸氢钠？血糖降到14以下以后为什么不能停胰岛素？“缓解”的标准是什么？为什么18–25岁的患者补液要谨慎？
knowledge.en: Socratic; never gives the answer outright and asks only about information the learner already has. Before the learner has committed to a diagnosis: what might the deep, fast breathing be compensating for? What can be checked at the bedside right now? How do you read the venous gas, and what is the anion gap? After the learner has committed: why is the measured sodium low, and what is the corrected value? Which parameter grades the severity? Why not insulin first? When would bicarbonate even be considered? Why can't insulin stop once glucose is below 14? What defines resolution? Why be careful with fluids in an 18–25-year-old?

title.zh-CN: 重度糖尿病酮症酸中毒伴入院低钾血症（胰岛素泵输注中断 + 病中漏打胰岛素 + 急性胃肠炎）
title.en: Severe diabetic ketoacidosis with admission hypokalaemia (pump delivery failure + insulin omitted during illness + acute gastroenteritis)

conclusion.zh-CN: 24岁1型糖尿病女性，使用胰岛素泵。急性胃肠炎期间泵管路打折堵塞（反复报警被清除、管路超期4天），同时因“不吃饭就不用胰岛素”的误解停打餐时和校正胰岛素，约2天后出现多饮多尿、呕吐、腹痛、库斯莫尔呼吸和酮味呼气。床旁血糖28.0 mmol/L、血β-羟丁酸5.8 mmol/L；静脉血气pH 7.08、HCO₃⁻ 7.0 mmol/L、阴离子间隙26；Na⁺ 131 mmol/L（校正后约137.5–140.8，正常）、K⁺ 3.2 mmol/L；心电图U波。诊断为重度DKA伴入院低钾血症，需2级（HDU）监护。正确处理：先补液（第1小时1 L等渗晶体液）；因钾 < 3.5 mmol/L暂缓胰岛素，先以20 mmol/h静脉补钾并持续心电监护；复查钾3.7 mmol/L后开始固定速率静脉胰岛素0.1 U/kg/h（5.5 U/h，无负荷量）；血糖 < 14 mmol/L时加10%葡萄糖125 mL/h并继续足量胰岛素；每小时监测血糖和血酮、定期复查静脉血气和钾；不用碳酸氢钠、不常规补磷、不用经验性抗生素。约10小时后血酮0.2 mmol/L、pH 7.35、HCO₃⁻ 19 mmol/L——DKA缓解；进食后给予甘精胰岛素18 U和餐时门冬胰岛素，重叠后停用静脉胰岛素，并由糖尿病专科进行泵故障处理和病假规则教育。
conclusion.en: A 24-year-old woman with type 1 diabetes on an insulin pump. During acute gastroenteritis her pump set kinked and occluded (alarms repeatedly cleared, set 4 days old) and she stopped meal and correction insulin believing 'no food, no insulin'. About 2 days later she had thirst, polyuria, vomiting, abdominal pain, Kussmaul breathing and ketotic breath. Capillary glucose 28.0 mmol/L, β-hydroxybutyrate 5.8 mmol/L; venous pH 7.08, HCO₃⁻ 7.0 mmol/L, anion gap 26; Na⁺ 131 mmol/L (corrected about 137.5–140.8, normal), K⁺ 3.2 mmol/L; U waves on the ECG. Diagnosis: severe DKA with admission hypokalaemia, needing level-2 (HDU) care. Correct management: fluids first (1 L isotonic crystalloid in hour 1); because K⁺ was < 3.5 mmol/L, insulin was held and potassium given at 20 mmol/h on continuous ECG monitoring; once the repeat K⁺ was 3.7 mmol/L, fixed-rate IV insulin at 0.1 U/kg/h (5.5 U/h, no bolus); 10% glucose 125 mL/h added with full-dose insulin continued when glucose fell below 14 mmol/L; hourly glucose and ketones with regular venous gas and potassium checks; no bicarbonate, no routine phosphate, no empirical antibiotics. After about 10 hours ketones were 0.2 mmol/L, pH 7.35 and HCO₃⁻ 19 mmol/L — DKA resolved; once she was eating she had glargine 18 U and meal-time aspart, the IV insulin was stopped after an overlap, and the diabetes team addressed pump troubleshooting and sick-day rules.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 诊断三联（2024年共识）：D——血糖 ≥ 11.1 mmol/L或已知糖尿病；K——血β-羟丁酸 ≥ 3.0 mmol/L（或尿酮 ≥ 2+）；A——pH < 7.3和/或HCO₃⁻ < 18 mmol/L。本例三项均明确满足；阴离子间隙 = Na⁺ −（Cl⁻ + HCO₃⁻）= 131 −（98 + 7）= 26 mmol/L，提示高阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒。
keyReasoning.en: Diagnostic triad (2024 consensus): D — glucose ≥ 11.1 mmol/L or known diabetes; K — β-hydroxybutyrate ≥ 3.0 mmol/L (or urine ketones ≥ 2+); A — pH < 7.3 and/or HCO₃⁻ < 18 mmol/L. She clearly meets all three; anion gap = Na⁺ − (Cl⁻ + HCO₃⁻) = 131 − (98 + 7) = 26 mmol/L, a high-anion-gap metabolic acidosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 严重程度按最差的指标判断：pH 7.08单看是“中度”，但HCO₃⁻ 7.0 mmol/L（< 10）为重度；JBDS提示需2级监护的指标她还有入院钾 < 3.5、心率 > 100、阴离子间隙 > 16（血酮5.8接近 > 6的阈值）。
keyReasoning.en: Grade by the worst parameter: pH 7.08 alone looks 'moderate', but HCO₃⁻ 7.0 mmol/L (< 10) is severe; she also has the JBDS level-2 markers of admission K⁺ < 3.5, HR > 100 and anion gap > 16 (ketones 5.8, just below the > 6 threshold).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 测得的低钠是高血糖把水分从细胞内吸出所致（转移性低钠）。校正钠：Katz公式131 + 1.6 ×（28.0 − 5.5）/ 5.5 ≈ 137.5 mmol/L；Hillier公式131 + 2.4 ×（28.0 − 5.5）/ 5.5 ≈ 140.8 mmol/L——均正常。有效渗透压2 × 131 + 28 = 290 mOsm/kg，低于HHS阈值（2024年共识 > 300；JBDS及中国指南 ≥ 320），不是HHS；治疗中随血糖下降，测得的钠逐步升到138，符合预期。
keyReasoning.en: The low measured sodium reflects water drawn out of cells by hyperglycaemia (translocational hyponatraemia). Corrected Na⁺: Katz 131 + 1.6 × (28.0 − 5.5)/5.5 ≈ 137.5 mmol/L; Hillier 131 + 2.4 × (28.0 − 5.5)/5.5 ≈ 140.8 mmol/L — both normal. Effective osmolality 2 × 131 + 28 = 290 mOsm/kg, below the HHS thresholds (2024 consensus > 300; JBDS and Chinese guideline ≥ 320), so not HHS; as glucose fell the measured sodium rose to 138, as expected.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: DKA时机体总钾严重缺乏，但酸中毒和胰岛素缺乏使钾移出细胞，血钾常正常甚至偏高；入院钾已经3.2 mmol/L说明缺钾非常严重。胰岛素和碳酸氢钠都会把钾驱回细胞内，所以必须先补钾，钾 ≥ 3.5 mmol/L后才开始胰岛素——补液本身已能降低血糖，推迟胰岛素约1小时是安全的。
keyReasoning.en: Total-body potassium is profoundly depleted in DKA, but acidosis and insulin deficiency shift potassium out of cells, so serum K⁺ is often normal or high; an admission K⁺ of 3.2 mmol/L means a very large deficit. Insulin and bicarbonate both drive potassium back into cells, so potassium comes first and insulin starts only once K⁺ ≥ 3.5 mmol/L — fluids alone already lower glucose, and delaying insulin by about an hour is safe.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 诱因：泵只输注速效胰岛素，没有长效储备，管路堵塞后数小时即可发生DKA；生病时停打胰岛素进一步加重。白细胞16.8和淀粉酶升高在DKA中常见且非特异；脂肪酶正常、尿hCG阴性、尿检无感染、胸片清晰，没有使用抗生素的指征。
keyReasoning.en: Precipitant: a pump delivers only rapid-acting insulin with no depot, so an occluded set can cause DKA within hours, made worse by stopping insulin while ill. A white count of 16.8 and a raised amylase are common and non-specific in DKA; normal lipase, negative hCG, a clean urine and a clear chest film give no indication for antibiotics.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血糖比酮体恢复得快：血糖 < 14 mmol/L时应加葡萄糖并继续足量胰岛素，而不是停胰岛素。缓解看血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L和静脉pH > 7.3（或HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18）（2024年共识/JBDS），不看血糖。缓解时HCO₃⁻ 19、Cl⁻ 108、阴离子间隙11——残余的轻度酸中毒是大量生理盐水造成的高氯性酸中毒，不是继续用胰岛素的理由。
keyReasoning.en: Glucose recovers before ketones: when glucose falls below 14 mmol/L add glucose and keep full-dose insulin rather than stopping it. Resolution means ketones < 0.6 mmol/L and venous pH > 7.3 (or HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18) (2024 consensus/JBDS), not a glucose value. At resolution HCO₃⁻ 19, Cl⁻ 108 and anion gap 11 — the residual mild acidosis is hyperchloraemic from large volumes of saline and is no reason to continue insulin.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是简化的教学模拟：化验结果按阶段给出快照，阶段内不随时间更新；生理模型用“胰岛素使血糖每小时下降约3.5 mmol/L”和“呼吸频率恢复”近似代表酸中毒纠正；皮下与静脉胰岛素的重叠时间由学员自行把握，引擎不强制计时；未模拟脑水肿、低磷性并发症或泵与多次皮下注射方案的个体化选择。各地方案（如ADA/EASD共识与英国JBDS在钾阈值、液体种类、葡萄糖浓度上的差异）可能不同，实际工作请遵循本单位方案。
boundaries.en: This is a simplified teaching simulation: results are per-phase snapshots that do not update within a phase; the physiology approximates resolution of acidosis by a glucose fall of about 3.5 mmol/L per hour on insulin and by the respiratory rate settling; the length of the IV/SC insulin overlap is left to the learner and not timed by the engine; cerebral oedema, complications of hypophosphataemia and the individual choice between pump and injections are not modelled. Local protocols (e.g. the ADA/EASD consensus and UK JBDS differ on potassium thresholds, fluid choice and glucose concentration) vary — follow your own institution's protocol in practice.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 先补液：无低血压时第1小时给1 L等渗晶体液（0.9%氯化钠或平衡液），之后按方案逐渐减慢；18–25岁年轻成人、心肾功能不全者补液需谨慎，并监测神经系统体征。
teachingPoints.en: Fluids first: without hypotension, 1 L of isotonic crystalloid (0.9% saline or balanced) in hour 1, then slower per protocol; be cautious and do neurological observations in young adults aged 18–25 and in heart or kidney failure.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 钾决定胰岛素的时机：钾 < 3.5 mmol/L——暂缓胰岛素，静脉补钾10–20 mmol/h（心电监护）直至 ≥ 3.5（中国2013指南以3.3 mmol/L为界）；钾3.5–5.5——每升液体加钾40 mmol（ADA为20–30 mmol/L）；钾 > 5.5——不加钾、2小时内复查。氯化钾绝不静推。
teachingPoints.en: Potassium decides when insulin starts: K⁺ < 3.5 mmol/L — hold insulin and give IV potassium 10–20 mmol/h on ECG monitoring until ≥ 3.5 (the Chinese 2013 guideline uses 3.3 mmol/L); K⁺ 3.5–5.5 — add 40 mmol per litre (ADA 20–30 mmol/L); K⁺ > 5.5 — none, recheck within 2 hours. Never push potassium.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 固定速率静脉胰岛素0.1 U/kg/h（本例5.5 U/h），不需要负荷量；目标：血酮每小时下降 ≥ 0.5 mmol/L（无法测血酮时：HCO₃⁻每小时上升 ≥ 3 mmol/L）、血糖每小时下降约3 mmol/L，未达标时按方案上调。
teachingPoints.en: Fixed-rate IV insulin 0.1 U/kg/h (5.5 U/h here), no bolus; targets: ketones falling ≥ 0.5 mmol/L/h (if ketones cannot be measured, HCO₃⁻ rising ≥ 3 mmol/L/h) and glucose falling about 3 mmol/L/h — increase per protocol if not met.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 血糖 < 14 mmol/L：加10%葡萄糖125 mL/h并继续胰岛素直到DKA缓解。碳酸氢钠仅在pH < 7.0时考虑；磷仅在 < 0.32 mmol/L或有并发症时补充。
teachingPoints.en: Glucose < 14 mmol/L: add 10% glucose 125 mL/h and continue insulin until the DKA resolves. Consider bicarbonate only if pH < 7.0, and phosphate only if < 0.32 mmol/L or with complications.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 缓解与过渡：血酮 < 0.6 mmol/L且静脉pH > 7.3（或HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18）、能进食后，先给皮下胰岛素（基础 + 餐时），静脉胰岛素重叠1–2小时再停。泵使用者在病愈并完成再教育前可暂改为皮下注射方案。
teachingPoints.en: Resolution and transition: once ketones are < 0.6 mmol/L and venous pH > 7.3 (or HCO₃⁻ ≥ 18) and she can eat, give subcutaneous insulin (basal + meal-time) first and stop the IV insulin after a 1–2 h overlap. Pump users may switch to injections until they are well and re-educated.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 预防复发：生病日规则（不停基础胰岛素、每2–4小时测血糖和血酮）、泵使用者“不明原因高血糖先测酮、有酮用笔式胰岛素校正并更换管路”、家中常备血酮试纸，以及糖尿病专科随访。
teachingPoints.en: Preventing recurrence: sick-day rules (never stop basal insulin, check glucose and ketones every 2–4 hours), the pump-user rule 'unexplained high glucose → check ketones; if present, correct by pen and change the set', blood-ketone strips at home, and diabetes-team follow-up.
